Translation: Chinese banks can no longer channel low-interest loans into useless investment projects without facing opposition from depositors.

Query_Text_cn: 如今不需要很多就能击垮中国股市的信心。
Translation: It doesn't take much these days to undermine confidence in China's stock market.

Query_Text_cn: 上证综指下滑2.6%，这是自去年11月以来的最大单日跌幅。投资者在担忧中国经济放缓之余，又开始担忧企业利润下滑。
Translation: The Shanghai Composite Index fell by 2.6%, marking its largest single-day decline since November last year. In addition to concerns about a slowdown in China's economy, investors are now worried about a drop in corporate profits.

Query_Text_cn: 去年中国工业企业利润同比增长25.4%，尽管在2011年最后几个月增速已经趋缓。
Translation: Last year, profits of Chinese industrial enterprises increased by 25.4% year-on-year, although the growth rate had already slowed in the final months of 2011.

Query_Text_cn: 法国兴业银行并未预计2009年的情形会再次上演——当时全球危机导致中国工业企业利润骤降20%。
Translation: Société Générale does not anticipate a repeat of the situation in 2009, when the global crisis led to a 20% plunge in profits for Chinese industrial enterprises.

Query_Text_cn: 但该行的确预计2012年中国工业企业利润总额将下降5%。
Translation: However, the bank does expect the total profits of Chinese industrial enterprises to decline by 5% in 2012.

Query_Text_cn: 法国兴业银行表示，这可能意味着恒生中国企业指数(HangSengChinaEnterprisesIndex)成分股企业的利润将持平。恒生中国企业指数跟踪在港上市的中国内地企业，国际投资者可以方便地投资于这些企业的股票。
Translation: Société Générale stated that this could mean the profits of companies included in the Hang Seng China Enterprises Index may remain flat. The Hang Seng China Enterprises Index tracks mainland Chinese companies listed in Hong Kong, allowing international investors to conveniently invest in their stocks.

Query_Text_cn: 这听起来还不错，但别忘了，市场共识预测是盈利将增长11%。
Translation: That sounds pretty good, but don't forget that the market consensus is forecasting an 11% increase in earnings.

Query_Text_cn: 继全球股市年初上涨之后，与其他新兴市场一样，中国股市3月大幅走低。
Translation: Following the global stock market rally at the beginning of the year, Chinese equities, like those in other emerging markets, fell sharply in March.

Query_Text_cn: 他呼吁继续调控房地产市场也在意料之中。
Translation: His call for continued regulation of the real estate market is also unsurprising.

Query_Text_cn: 他在本周宣布的严厉政策（包括禁止高官用公款购买香烟和高档白酒）同样如此。
Translation: The stringent policies he announced this week, including banning senior officials from using public funds to purchase cigarettes and premium liquor, are equally so.

Query_Text_cn: 他的话对中国白酒股产生了直接影响，尤其是宴会用酒生产商贵州茅台(KweichowMoutai)。
Translation: His remarks had a direct impact on Chinese baijiu stocks, especially Kweichow Moutai, a producer of liquor commonly used at banquets.

Query_Text_cn: 该股周二大跌6.5%。
Translation: The stock plunged 6.5% on Tuesday.

Query_Text_cn: 直到去年，这栋楼里还运行着一条手机生产线。
Translation: Until last year, a mobile phone production line was still operating in this building.

Query_Text_cn: 在全球手机业中心深圳，此类工厂关门事件近来非常普遍。
Translation: In Shenzhen, the global hub of the mobile phone industry, such factory closures have become increasingly common recently.

Query_Text_cn: 有些公司根据最新版的品牌手机推出低价的仿制版本，但也有公司根据中国农民工、小镇商人和农民的需求与喜好生产新型手机，比如有些手机镶上了人造水晶，还有些手机装上了声音超大的扩音器和待机时间长的电池——这样他们就可以在吵闹的建筑工地收听广播节目。
Translation: Some companies release low-cost imitation versions based on the latest branded smartphones, while others develop new models tailored to the needs and preferences of Chinese migrant workers, small-town merchants, and farmers. For example, some phones are adorned with artificial crystals, while others are equipped with powerful loudspeakers and long-lasting batteries—allowing users to listen to radio programs even on noisy construction sites.

Query_Text_cn: 白标制造商的产品不是没有品牌，就是使用一些基本没人听说过的品牌，而售价只是一部诺基亚(Nokia)手机的几分之一。
Translation: White-label manufacturers' products are either unbranded or use little-known brands, and are sold at just a fraction of the price of a Nokia phone.

Query_Text_cn: 在2010年，此类手机的生产商大概占据了中国市场的半壁江山，但它们目前都在困境中挣扎。
Translation: In 2010, manufacturers of such phones accounted for roughly half of the Chinese market, but they are now struggling in difficult circumstances.

Query_Text_cn: 研究公司Gartner估计，2011年白标手机销售量下降了7%，降至1.86亿部（占全国手机销量的42%），今年还将再降30%。
Translation: Research firm Gartner estimates that sales of white-label phones declined by 7% in 2011, falling to 186 million units (accounting for 42% of national mobile phone sales), and are expected to drop by another 30% this year.

Query_Text_cn: 其中一个原因是中国推出了3G服务，这意味着消费者希望使用手机上网。
Translation: One reason is that China has launched 3G services, which means consumers want to access the internet on their mobile phones.

Query_Text_cn: 运营商还对智能手机进行补贴，并把它们推向白标手机曾占统治地位的中国小城镇市场。
Translation: Operators also subsidize smartphones and promote them in small Chinese towns where white-label phones once dominated the market.

Query_Text_cn: 其结果是，数百家白标手机制造商已经关门。
Translation: As a result, hundreds of white-label mobile phone manufacturers have shut down.

Query_Text_cn: 但对其中的一些公司而言，行业洗牌也是一种机遇。
Translation: However, for some of these companies, industry reshuffling also presents an opportunity.

Query_Text_cn: 在离硅谷动力产业园这家关门的公司不远的地方，一家中等规模的中国手机制造商赛博宇华(SOPGroup)却正在进行扩张。
Translation: Not far from the closed company in the Silicon Valley Power Industrial Park, a medium-sized Chinese mobile phone manufacturer, SOPGroup, is undergoing expansion.

Query_Text_cn: 赛博宇华每月手机产量大约为30万部，目前约一半是智能手机。
Translation: Cyber Yuhua produces approximately 300,000 mobile phones per month, with about half of them being smartphones.

Query_Text_cn: 天语(K-Touch)、金立(Gionee)、酷派(Coolpad)、魅族(Meizu)、Oppo和步步高(Bubugao)等公司也在悄悄地建立自己的品牌，形成一股发达市场尚未注意到的力量。在发达市场，电信设备制造商华为(Huawei)已进入消费者市场，并引起了轰动。
Translation: Companies such as K-Touch, Gionee, Coolpad, Meizu, Oppo, and Bubugao are also quietly building their own brands, forming a force that has yet to be noticed in developed markets. In developed markets, telecommunications equipment manufacturer Huawei has already entered the consumer market and caused a sensation.

Query_Text_cn: 二线手机制造商的日子并不好过。
Translation: Life is not easy for second-tier mobile phone manufacturers.

Query_Text_cn: 由于运营商的补贴，它们的产品与全球品牌智能手机之间的价差，远远小于过去低端多功能手机与国际品牌手机之间的价差。
Translation: Due to subsidies from operators, the price gap between their products and global brand smartphones is much smaller than the gap that previously existed between low-end feature phones and international brand phones.

Query_Text_cn: 这些手机制造商还发现，要使自己的手机脱颖而出变得更加困难了。
Translation: These smartphone manufacturers have also found it increasingly difficult to make their devices stand out.

Query_Text_cn: 这些公司采取了不同的应对策略。
Translation: These companies have adopted different response strategies.

Query_Text_cn: 有些公司主打细分市场。
Translation: Some companies focus on niche markets.

Query_Text_cn: Oppo和步步高已经成功地将自己定位于女性手机品牌。这两家公司位于距离深圳不远的工业城市东莞市。
Translation: Oppo and BBK have successfully positioned themselves as mobile phone brands for women. Both companies are located in Dongguan, an industrial city not far from Shenzhen.

Query_Text_cn: 同时，酷派则在与移动运营商进行密切合作。
Translation: Meanwhile, Coolpad is closely cooperating with mobile operators.

Query_Text_cn: 在与深圳隔珠江相望的珠海市，本土手机品牌魅族也像苹果(Apple)一样，开设了自己的应用商店。
Translation: In Zhuhai, a city across the Pearl River from Shenzhen, the local smartphone brand Meizu has also established its own app store, much like Apple.

Query_Text_cn: 另一个增长领域是发达程度尚不如中国的海外市场。
Translation: Another area of growth is overseas markets that are less developed than China.

Query_Text_cn: 目前，赛博宇华通过其设在印尼、印度和加纳的办事处，将手机产量的大约三分之一出口到海外市场。
Translation: Currently, Cyber Yuhua exports approximately one-third of its mobile phone production to overseas markets through its offices in Indonesia, India, and Ghana.

Query_Text_cn: 尽管存在诸多挑战，但快速增长的智能手机市场应该会为中国二线品牌提供一定的发展空间。
Translation: Despite numerous challenges, the rapidly growing smartphone market is expected to provide some room for development for China's second-tier brands.

Query_Text_cn: 但是，如果你去问约翰•科茨(JohnCoates)，他会告诉你可能还有一项因素在起作用，那就是荷尔蒙。科茨曾在德意志银行(DeutscheBank)和高盛(GoldmanSachs)任资深交易员。
Translation: However, if you ask John Coates, he will tell you that there may be another factor at play: hormones. Coates was a senior trader at Deutsche Bank and Goldman Sachs.

Query_Text_cn: 离开银行业之后，科茨在剑桥大学(CambridgeUniversity)经过再学习成为了一名神经学家。在剑桥，他与一个团队共同分析了金融交易员的生命科学特性。
Translation: After leaving the banking industry, Coates retrained at Cambridge University to become a neuroscientist. At Cambridge, he worked with a team to analyze the life science characteristics of financial traders.

Query_Text_cn: 无论以哪种标准衡量，这都意味着，围绕金融展开的争论中出现了一个可能具有重要意义的新转折。
Translation: By any standard, this signifies a potentially significant new turning point in the ongoing debates surrounding finance.

Query_Text_cn: 10年前，经济学等学科的研究往往只在各自领域内展开。
Translation: Ten years ago, research in economics and other disciplines was often conducted solely within their respective fields.

Query_Text_cn: 但到目前为止，人们还没有付出那么大的努力来把经济学与神经学结合起来，更不必说与生物学结合起来了。
Translation: But so far, not much effort has been made to integrate economics with neuroscience, let alone with biology.

Query_Text_cn: 这在一定程度上是因为，各学科所处的细分学术领域是如此的不同。
Translation: This is partly because the subfields in which each discipline operates are so different.

Query_Text_cn: 我们就以睾酮（与雄性特征、以及攻击性和冒险性关系最密切的荷尔蒙）为例吧。
Translation: Let's take testosterone—the hormone most closely associated with male characteristics, aggression, and risk-taking—as an example.

Query_Text_cn: 研究表明，金融交易员体内的睾酮水平一般要高于普罗大众；而且通常而言，交易员们只要一踏入交易大厅，睾酮水平马上就会上升。
Translation: Research shows that financial traders generally have higher testosterone levels than the general population; moreover, their testosterone levels typically rise as soon as they step onto the trading floor.

Query_Text_cn: 从某种意义上说，睾酮水平高可能是件好事。
Translation: In a sense, having high testosterone levels can be a good thing.

Query_Text_cn: 当危险逼近时，皮质醇水平通常会上升，令我们在短期内受益，因为它会强化我们的防御本能。
Translation: When danger approaches, cortisol levels typically rise, which benefits us in the short term by strengthening our defensive instincts.

Query_Text_cn: 但如果要长时间承受难以预知的压力，皮质醇水平就会高企。
Translation: However, if one is subjected to unpredictable stress for an extended period, cortisol levels will remain elevated.

Query_Text_cn: 这会损害人的认知分析能力，助长非理性的悲观心态和避险情绪。
Translation: This undermines people's cognitive analytical abilities and fosters irrational pessimism and risk-averse sentiment.

Query_Text_cn: 科茨将2008年末和2009年金融市场的表现，归因于交易员皮质醇水平过高。
Translation: Coates attributed the performance of financial markets in late 2008 and 2009 to excessively high cortisol levels among traders.

Query_Text_cn: 接下来说说迷走神经。
Translation: Next, let's talk about the vagus nerve.

Query_Text_cn: 官能受损的交易员会失去迷走张力。
Translation: Traders with impaired sensory function will lose vagal tone.

Query_Text_cn: 科茨提出了两个办法。
Translation: Coase proposed two solutions.

Query_Text_cn: 第二，他希望银行的交易部门能多招聘一些女性交易员和年纪较长的男性交易员，这么做不是为了体现政治正确性，而是因为他们的睾酮水平通常较低、迷走神经官能更健全。
Translation: Second, he hopes that banks' trading departments will hire more female traders and older male traders—not to demonstrate political correctness, but because their testosterone levels are generally lower and their vagal nerve function is typically healthier.

Query_Text_cn: 他坚称，交易员的整体生理状况越健康，睾酮和皮质醇水平的波动幅度就越小，市场的戏剧性震荡也会越少。
Translation: He insists that the healthier traders are overall, the smaller the fluctuations in their testosterone and cortisol levels, and the less dramatic the market swings will be.

Query_Text_cn: 正如我前面提到的，透过生理特性这个“棱镜”来审视员工是一种禁忌，更不必说带有冒犯性的检测、或基于性别和年龄的雇佣政策了。
Translation: As I mentioned earlier, viewing employees through the "prism" of physiological characteristics is taboo, not to mention offensive testing or employment policies based on gender and age.

Query_Text_cn: 但科茨的研究至少表明一点，那就是投资者和监管人士应当讨论一下上述问题，特别是考虑到市场眼下正在回升。
Translation: But at the very least, Coates's research suggests that investors and regulators should discuss these issues, especially given the current market recovery.

Query_Text_cn: 但最终受到伤害的并不仅仅是交易员自己，还有睾酮水平更低的普罗大众。
Translation: But ultimately, it is not only the traders themselves who are harmed, but also the general public with lower testosterone levels.

Query_Text_cn: 中国工商银行(ICBC)昨天公布称，2011年该行中东子银行的贷款额、存款额和利润都增长了1倍以上，原因是中国和中东地区之间的贸易融资需求十分旺盛。
Translation: Industrial and Commercial Bank of China (ICBC) announced yesterday that in 2011, its Middle East subsidiary saw its loan volume, deposit volume, and profits more than double, due to strong demand for trade financing between China and the Middle East.

Query_Text_cn: 贷款额以大致相同的速度增长，客户贷款及垫款结余达到26.3亿美元，增幅为148%。
Translation: Loan balances grew at a roughly similar pace, with customer loans and advances reaching $2.63 billion, an increase of 148%.

Query_Text_cn: 中国的制造业成本已经不再那么低廉，这并非什么秘密。
Translation: It is no secret that manufacturing costs in China are no longer as low as they used to be.

Query_Text_cn: 但现在，中国市场的销售成本也变得越来越高。
Translation: However, the cost of sales in the Chinese market is also becoming increasingly high.

Query_Text_cn: 销售多个品牌奢侈品的零售企业奈曼-马库斯(NeimanMarcus)，计划以电子商务方式进军中国，而不打算在那里建立传统的实体店。
Translation: Neiman Marcus, a retail company selling multiple luxury brands, plans to enter the Chinese market through e-commerce rather than establishing traditional brick-and-mortar stores there.

Query_Text_cn: 奈曼-马库斯并不是唯一一家这样做的企业。
Translation: Neiman Marcus is not the only company doing this.

Query_Text_cn: 上周五发布的一份报告显示，受中国营商成本飞涨的影响，一些手中拥有新产品的外国企业正在远离传统零售商，转而投入电子商务企业的怀抱。
Translation: A report released last Friday shows that, due to the soaring cost of doing business in China, some foreign companies with new products are turning away from traditional retailers and instead embracing e-commerce enterprises.

Query_Text_cn: 希望进入中国市场的零售商面临两重问题。
Translation: Retailers hoping to enter the Chinese market face a dual challenge.

Query_Text_cn: 中国当地的零售业分析师对奈曼-马库斯的做法持怀疑态度。
Translation: Local retail analysts in China are skeptical about Neiman Marcus's approach.

Query_Text_cn: 数年来一直有传言称，奈曼-马库斯试图在上海外滩搞块零售店面，开一家新的大型门店。
Translation: For years, there have been rumors that Neiman Marcus has been trying to secure a retail space on the Bund in Shanghai to open a new flagship store.

Query_Text_cn: 但实体零售店的成本可能会迫使外国品牌重新做出考虑。
Translation: However, the costs associated with physical retail stores may compel foreign brands to reconsider their strategies.

Query_Text_cn: 此外，劳动力、场租、物流和营销成本也在急剧上涨。
Translation: In addition, labor, venue rental, logistics, and marketing costs are also rising sharply.

Query_Text_cn: 过去五年间，分销成本上升了200%。
Translation: Over the past five years, distribution costs have increased by 200%.

Query_Text_cn: 仓储成本去年提高了23%。而在中国中央电视台(CCTV)做广告的成本自2007年以来已提高了近50%。
Translation: Warehouse costs increased by 23% last year. Meanwhile, the cost of advertising on China Central Television (CCTV) has risen by nearly 50% since 2007.

Query_Text_cn: 过去三年里，在中国较富裕地区雇佣较有经验白领的成本提高了近60%。
Translation: Over the past three years, the cost of hiring experienced white-collar workers in China's more affluent regions has increased by nearly 60%.

Query_Text_cn: 因此，企业开始避开传统零售商。
Translation: Therefore, companies have begun to bypass traditional retailers.

Query_Text_cn: 在线零售商“一号店”正在努力抓住这个商业机遇，手段是为新进入市场的企业提供一站式店铺服务。沃尔玛(Walmart)最近刚把在一号店的持股比例提高到51%。
Translation: Online retailer Yihaodian is striving to seize this business opportunity by offering one-stop store services to newly entering enterprises. Walmart recently increased its stake in Yihaodian to 51%.

Query_Text_cn: 一号店会帮助它们注册品牌、处理进口手续、运输、物流和广告等事宜。
Translation: Yihaodian will assist them with brand registration, handling import procedures, transportation, logistics, and advertising.

Query_Text_cn: 想将自己的新产品引入中国市场的外国企业，纷纷请求进驻一号店。最近六个月，这类请求的数量大幅增长。
Translation: Foreign companies seeking to introduce their new products into the Chinese market are increasingly requesting to enter Yihaodian. Over the past six months, the number of such requests has risen significantly.

Query_Text_cn: 2011年第四季度，这家在线零售商的网店中出售的产品已激增至18万种，而一年之前只有区区5万种。
Translation: In the fourth quarter of 2011, the number of products sold in the online retailer's store surged to 180,000, compared to just 50,000 a year earlier.

Query_Text_cn: 全球金融危机爆发之后不久，中国银行业就面临着麻烦，这一点似乎是显而易见的。
Translation: Not long after the outbreak of the global financial crisis, it seemed obvious that China's banking sector would soon face trouble.

Query_Text_cn: 中国政府指示银行向增长放缓的经济大举放贷，银行则报以热烈回应，其热烈程度反映出了国有机构的服从意识。
Translation: The Chinese government has instructed banks to significantly increase lending to the slowing economy, and banks have responded enthusiastically, with their fervor reflecting the obedience of state-owned institutions.

Query_Text_cn: 2009年，中国银行业的放贷规模激增，达到前所未有的水平，这注定要引发一轮违约潮——或者说非常多的外部人士持有这样的看法。
Translation: In 2009, the scale of lending by Chinese banks surged to unprecedented levels, which was bound to trigger a wave of defaults—or at least, this was the view held by many external observers.

Query_Text_cn: 但是，这种情况并未出现。
Translation: However, this situation did not occur.

Query_Text_cn: 是政府管制。最早让银行痛苦不堪的政府管制，后来反而成了它们的救命草。
Translation: It is government regulation. The government regulations that initially caused banks great distress later became their lifeline.

Query_Text_cn: 危险的苗头刚一出现，中国政府就策划了一连串的银行股增发，协调了大量问题贷款的展期，出台了减轻企业还款负担的计划，并且承诺为部分贷款提供担保。
Translation: As soon as signs of danger emerged, the Chinese government orchestrated a series of bank share issuances, coordinated the extension of numerous problematic loans, introduced plans to ease corporate repayment burdens, and pledged guarantees for certain loans.

Query_Text_cn: 国家控制的银行体系具有毋庸置疑的好处。
Translation: There are undeniable benefits to a state-controlled banking system.

Query_Text_cn: 当面对市场动荡时，西方的银行使问题更加恶化。
Translation: When facing market turmoil, Western banks exacerbate the problem.

Query_Text_cn: 它们彼此之间更加惜贷，把市场对少数机构的担忧转变成整个银行体系的信用紧缩。
Translation: They have become more reluctant to lend to each other, turning market concerns about a few institutions into a credit tightening across the entire banking system.

Query_Text_cn: 但当中国面临贷款收缩时，政府只需要指示银行增加放贷。
Translation: But when China faces a credit contraction, the government simply instructs banks to increase lending.

Query_Text_cn: 批评人士经常提到中国银行模式所蕴含的经济风险。
Translation: Critics often highlight the economic risks inherent in the Chinese banking model.

Query_Text_cn: 不良贷款未充分确认，资本大范围错配。
Translation: Non-performing loans have not been fully recognized, and there is widespread capital misallocation.

Query_Text_cn: 这些隐患总有一天会酿成恶果。
Translation: These hidden dangers will inevitably lead to disastrous consequences one day.

Query_Text_cn: 虽然这还不至于在北京引发“占领金融街”运动，但由于努力为银行辩护，监管者们发现自己已陷入尴尬境地。
Translation: Although this has not yet triggered an "Occupy Financial Street" movement in Beijing, regulators have found themselves in an awkward position as they strive to defend the banks.

Query_Text_cn: 分析师预计，中国工商银行下周公布的年度净利润将达到2080亿元人民币（合329亿美元）。
Translation: Analysts expect that the Industrial and Commercial Bank of China will report an annual net profit of 208 billion yuan ($32.9 billion) next week.

Query_Text_cn: 虽然他说的可能是实情，但这种周期性趋势对中国仅仅部分适用。
Translation: Although what he said may be true, this cyclical trend is only partially applicable to China.

Query_Text_cn: 在中国，人们的批评主要集中在对储户不利的银行业规定上。
Translation: In China, criticism is primarily focused on banking regulations that are unfavorable to depositors.

Query_Text_cn: 根据政府的规定，存款利息的上限比贷款利率低3个百分点左右，这保证了银行能轻松地赚到利润。
Translation: According to government regulations, the maximum deposit interest rate is about three percentage points lower than the lending rate, ensuring that banks can easily earn profits.

Query_Text_cn: 据监管机构的数据，息差带来的利润占银行利润的三分之二。
Translation: According to data from regulatory authorities, profits generated from interest spreads account for two-thirds of banks' total earnings.

Query_Text_cn: 同时，由于政府禁止私人集团开办银行，国有银行在银行业的垄断地位十分稳固。
Translation: Meanwhile, due to the government's prohibition on private groups establishing banks, state-owned banks maintain a very solid monopoly in the banking sector.

Query_Text_cn: 中国银行业协会(CBA)副会长杨再平竭力把银行家描述为广大民众利益的积极捍卫者。
Translation: Yang Zaiping, Vice President of the China Banking Association (CBA), has made every effort to portray bankers as active defenders of the interests of the general public.

Query_Text_cn: 杨再平没有说到点子上。
Translation: Yang Zaiping did not address the key issue.

Query_Text_cn: 中国确实没有付出直接为银行纾困的代价，但是，设定存款利率上限和限制银行业竞争的规定，却把大量隐形税加在了储户身上。
Translation: China has indeed not paid the direct cost of bailing out banks, but by setting caps on deposit interest rates and restricting competition in the banking sector, it has imposed a substantial hidden tax on depositors.

Query_Text_cn: 批评归批评。
Translation: Criticism is criticism.

Query_Text_cn: 理财产品向储户支付更高的利息，迫使各家银行展开利率竞争，这会侵蚀银行的利润率，并最终降低其利润。
Translation: Wealth management products pay higher interest to depositors, forcing banks to compete on interest rates. This erodes banks' profit margins and ultimately reduces their profits.

Query_Text_cn: 尽管危机远未发生，但这一趋势值得银行警惕。
Translation: Although the crisis is far from occurring, this trend warrants caution from banks.

Query_Text_cn: 令中国银行业模式走向破产的，可能不是纯经济因素，而是公众的愤怒。
Translation: What may lead to the collapse of China's banking model is not purely economic factors, but public outrage.

Query_Text_cn: 先来看好消息：中国农业银行(AgriculturalBankofChina)更多农村支行可以享受更低的法定准备金率，此举旨在促进农村信贷，对农行是好事。
Translation: Let's start with the good news: More rural branches of the Agricultural Bank of China can now benefit from a lower required reserve ratio. This move aims to promote rural lending and is positive for the bank.

Query_Text_cn: 中国银行业出现下滑已在预期当中。
Translation: The decline in China's banking sector has been anticipated.

Query_Text_cn: 这些银行的不良贷款数据值得关注。
Translation: The non-performing loan data of these banks warrants attention.

Query_Text_cn: 以往的先例实在无法令人鼓舞。
Translation: Past precedents have been far from encouraging.

Query_Text_cn: 2009年，这些不良贷款被再次延期10年。
Translation: In 2009, these non-performing loans were extended for another ten years.

Query_Text_cn: 投资者似乎确信有关方面不会放手不管。
Translation: Investors appear confident that the relevant authorities will not simply stand by and do nothing.

Query_Text_cn: 最理想的情况是把不良贷款出售给第三方。
Translation: The ideal scenario is to sell non-performing loans to a third party.

Query_Text_cn: 不过，西方同行为了避免类似命运而经历的曲折表明，问题不会这么轻易解决。
Translation: However, the twists and turns experienced by Western counterparts to avoid a similar fate indicate that the issue will not be resolved so easily.

Query_Text_cn: 英国首相戴维•卡梅隆(DavidCameron)上周对纽约人说，英国燃油价格之高（柴油2.3美元/升）会把他们吓晕（纽约的柴油价格低了一半左右）。
Translation: British Prime Minister David Cameron told New Yorkers last week that the high fuel prices in the UK—diesel at $2.30 per liter—would shock them, as diesel prices in New York are about half that amount.

Query_Text_cn: 中石化(Sinopec)和中石油(PetroChina)都报告称，由于炼油利润率下降，去年上半年盈利受到冲击。炼油业务在这两家公司中的比重都超过了四分之一。
Translation: Both Sinopec and PetroChina reported that their profits were hit in the first half of last year due to declining refining margins. Refining operations account for more than a quarter of the business in both companies.

Query_Text_cn: 之后原油价格上涨，预计加剧了两家公司炼油业务的亏损状态。
Translation: Subsequent increases in crude oil prices are expected to have exacerbated the losses in the refining operations of both companies.

Query_Text_cn: 无怪乎自周一出现油价上涨的传言以来，这两只股票的表现落后于恒生指数。
Translation: No wonder these two stocks have underperformed the Hang Seng Index since rumors of rising oil prices emerged on Monday.

Query_Text_cn: 不过，自去年10月原油价格开始上涨以来，中石油和中石化股价已经分别上涨了四分之一和五分之一，部分原因在于人们对中国放松油价管制抱有希望。
Translation: However, since crude oil prices began to rise last October, the share prices of PetroChina and Sinopec have increased by a quarter and a fifth, respectively, partly due to hopes that China will relax its controls on oil prices.

Query_Text_cn: 这也意味着，成品油价格可能会继续上调，但中国政府对于改革成品油定价机制只字未提。
Translation: This also means that refined oil prices may continue to rise, but the Chinese government has not mentioned any reform of the refined oil pricing mechanism.

Query_Text_cn: 中国成品油价格机制需要改革。
Translation: China's refined oil pricing mechanism needs to be reformed.

Query_Text_cn: 中国经济工作的重心正从抑通胀向促增长转移，但中国仍希望控制未来价格上涨的步伐。
Translation: The focus of China's economic policy is shifting from curbing inflation to promoting growth, but China still aims to keep future price increases under control.

Query_Text_cn: 由五个新兴经济体组成的金砖国家(Brics)集团的领导人昨日宣布，他们已就建立一家开发银行达成一致，但他们未能提供有关该机构规模或结构的任何细节。金砖国家的这家开发银行最终可能挑战布雷顿森林(BrettonWoods)体系机构的影响力。
Translation: The leaders of the BRICS group, composed of five emerging economies, announced yesterday that they had reached an agreement to establish a development bank, but failed to provide any details regarding the size or structure of the institution. The BRICS development bank may eventually challenge the influence of Bretton Woods institutions.

Query_Text_cn: 巴西、俄罗斯、印度、中国和南非领导人正齐聚南非德班，举行金砖国家南非峰会。建立一家开发银行是此次峰会的关键主题，此举被视为一个考验，看这个国家俱乐部能否拿出超越松散政治“抱团”范畴的东西。
Translation: Leaders from Brazil, Russia, India, China, and South Africa are gathering in Durban, South Africa, for the BRICS Summit. Establishing a development bank is a key theme of the summit, and this move is seen as a test to determine whether this club of nations can deliver something beyond loose political alliances.

Query_Text_cn: 五国领导人都明确支持建立开发银行的举措，他们在讲话中大力呼吁扩大金砖国家之间的合作，并提到世界秩序正在转变、西方仍在艰难应对自己的经济困境。
Translation: The leaders of the five countries all explicitly supported the initiative to establish a development bank. In their speeches, they strongly called for expanding cooperation among BRICS countries and mentioned that the world order is undergoing changes while the West is still struggling to cope with its own economic difficulties.

Query_Text_cn: 但他们同样没有透露这个外汇储备库将采用什么架构、或者如何落实。
Translation: However, they have also not disclosed what kind of structure this foreign exchange reserve pool will adopt or how it will be implemented.

Query_Text_cn: 这些举措是金砖国家在扩大相互合作之际创建正式机构的努力。这五个国家加起来占全球本地生产总值(GDP)的大约20%。
Translation: These measures represent the BRICS countries' efforts to establish formal institutions as they expand mutual cooperation. Together, these five countries account for approximately 20% of the world's gross domestic product (GDP).

Query_Text_cn: 建立开发银行和外汇储备库，还反映出他们对自己眼中世界银行(WorldBank)和国际货币基金组织(IMF)由西方占主导地位的过时安排感到沮丧。
Translation: The establishment of development banks and foreign exchange reserve pools also reflects their frustration with what they see as the outdated Western-dominated arrangements of the World Bank and the International Monetary Fund (IMF).

Query_Text_cn: 塞浦路斯危机或许是经济茶杯里的一场风暴。
Translation: The Cyprus crisis may be nothing more than a storm in an economic teacup.

Query_Text_cn: 但对于更大的载体（包括整个欧元区）来说，它提供了重要的教训。
Translation: But for larger entities, including the entire eurozone, it offers important lessons.

Query_Text_cn: 但另一些则令人不安。
Translation: But others are troubling.

Query_Text_cn: 欧元区依然深陷于可怕的混乱。
Translation: The eurozone remains deeply mired in dreadful turmoil.

Query_Text_cn: 预料之中的是，这一想法在塞浦路斯和欧元区其他地区都不受欢迎。
Translation: As expected, this idea is unpopular both in Cyprus and elsewhere in the eurozone.

Query_Text_cn: 当前的计划更接近人们所期望的有序银行清盘。
Translation: The current plan is closer to the orderly bank liquidation that people expect.

Query_Text_cn: 塞浦路斯大众银行(LaikiBank)将被拆分为“好银行”和“坏银行”。
Translation: Laiki Bank of Cyprus will be split into a "good bank" and a "bad bank."

Query_Text_cn: 剩下来的将得到清盘。
Translation: The remainder will be liquidated.

Query_Text_cn: 最后，当局还将实施临时的资本管制措施。
Translation: Finally, the authorities will also implement temporary capital control measures.

Query_Text_cn: 从这一局面可得出什么结论？我认为至少有四个教训。
Translation: What conclusions can be drawn from this situation? I believe there are at least four lessons.

Query_Text_cn: 首先，欧元区最终确实有能力采取正确的行动，尽管这是在尝试了其他所有方案之后。
Translation: First, the eurozone ultimately does have the capacity to take the right action, although this only happens after all other options have been tried.

Query_Text_cn: 但所有这些替代方案都需要在成员国及人民之间具有某种程度的团结，这种团结目前（乃至可预见的未来）不存在。
Translation: But all these alternatives require a certain degree of solidarity among member states and their peoples, which does not exist at present, nor is it likely to exist in the foreseeable future.

Query_Text_cn: 考虑到人们不愿意直接援助塞浦路斯，目前的计划几乎肯定是最能说得过去的。
Translation: Given the reluctance to provide direct aid to Cyprus, the current plan is almost certainly the most justifiable option.

Query_Text_cn: 它保护小储户，同时强制实行一个理智的清盘过程。
Translation: It protects small depositors while enforcing a rational liquidation process.

Query_Text_cn: 国际货币基金组织(IMF)将会满意。
Translation: The International Monetary Fund (IMF) will be satisfied.

Query_Text_cn: 令人敬畏的欧元集团主席、荷兰财政部长杰伦•迪塞布洛姆(JeroenDijsselbloem)也是如此，他认为对债权人采取强硬立场对欧元区来说是正确的。
Translation: The same goes for the formidable Eurogroup President and Dutch Finance Minister Jeroen Dijsselbloem, who believes that taking a tough stance toward creditors is the right approach for the eurozone.

Query_Text_cn: 第二，一欧元不是在哪都是一欧元。
Translation: Second, one euro is not always worth one euro everywhere.

Query_Text_cn: 虽然一欧元的纸币就是一欧元纸币，但实际上几乎所有欧元都是银行负债。
Translation: Although a one-euro banknote is simply a one-euro banknote, in reality, almost all euros are bank liabilities.

Query_Text_cn: 塞浦路斯的结果突显了一个事实，即作为银行负债的一欧元的价值，取决于银行本身以及银行背后政府的偿债能力。
Translation: The outcome in Cyprus highlights a fact: the value of one euro as a bank liability depends on the solvency of the bank itself and the government backing it.

Query_Text_cn: 资本管制往往是这样，冰岛就是例子。
Translation: Capital controls often work this way, and Iceland is a case in point.

Query_Text_cn: 然而，正如智库布鲁盖尔研究所(Bruegel)的贡特拉姆•沃尔夫(GuntramWolff)所说，“实行内部外汇管制的货币联盟”在词义上就是矛盾的。
Translation: However, as Guntram Wolff of the Bruegel think tank has pointed out, a "monetary union with internal capital controls" is, by definition, a contradiction in terms.

Query_Text_cn: 只有在欧洲央行(ECB)愿意无限制向塞浦路斯各银行提供资金的情况下，才有望在近期结束这种管制。
Translation: Only if the European Central Bank (ECB) is willing to provide unlimited funding to Cypriot banks is there hope of ending such controls in the near future.

Query_Text_cn: 来自塞浦路斯的第三个教训是，银行、主权国家、以及欧元区之间的联系，比人们以往得到的印象要复杂得多。
Translation: The third lesson from Cyprus is that the connections among banks, sovereign states, and the eurozone are far more complex than previously perceived.

Query_Text_cn: 我们可以认为，针对塞浦路斯的行动不能说明欧元区什么问题。
Translation: We can consider that the actions taken regarding Cyprus do not indicate any issues within the Eurozone.

Query_Text_cn: 或者，我们也可以认为这是一个样板，但只适用于有类似脆弱状况的国家。
Translation: Alternatively, we can consider this as a model, but one that is only applicable to countries with similar vulnerabilities.

Query_Text_cn: 或者也可以将它视为所有欧元区国家的样板——除非发生2008年那么严重的金融危机。
Translation: Alternatively, it can also be regarded as a model for all eurozone countries—unless a financial crisis as severe as that of 2008 occurs.

Query_Text_cn: 最后，一名观察人士可能相信，塞浦路斯是任何情况下所有欧元区国家的样板。
Translation: Finally, an observer might believe that Cyprus serves as a model for all eurozone countries under any circumstances.

Query_Text_cn: 没有人知道。
Translation: No one knows.

Query_Text_cn: 但很可能是第一个或者第二个。
Translation: But it is most likely the first or the second.

Query_Text_cn: 如果一家银行变得资不抵债应该由债权人（而不是纳税人）买单——围绕这种原则的共识在欧元区尚不存在。
Translation: If a bank becomes insolvent, creditors—not taxpayers—should bear the cost. However, there is still no consensus on this principle within the eurozone.

Query_Text_cn: 它当然会出手救援。
Translation: It will certainly step in to provide assistance.

Query_Text_cn: 塞浦路斯乱局的理想结局是，欧元区所有银行都应当拥有更多资本。
Translation: The ideal outcome of the Cyprus turmoil is that all banks in the eurozone should have more capital.

Query_Text_cn: 的确，由于货币联盟成员国财政能力有限，其银行可以说比其他地方的银行需要具备更充足的资本。
Translation: Indeed, due to the limited fiscal capacity of member states in a monetary union, their banks arguably need to maintain even higher levels of capital than banks elsewhere.

Query_Text_cn: 但实际结局可能不同：最安全的银行将是那些位于财政最稳健国家的银行。
Translation: But the actual outcome may be different: the safest banks will be those located in countries with the soundest fiscal positions.

Query_Text_cn: 这一结局的替代方案就是一个真正的银行业联盟。
Translation: The alternative to this outcome is a genuine banking union.

Query_Text_cn: 但那将要求要么建立财政联盟，要么愿意对所有银行都实行同样的严厉清盘机制。
Translation: But that would require either establishing a fiscal union or being willing to apply the same stringent resolution mechanism to all banks.

Query_Text_cn: 这两种情形都不太可能出现。
Translation: Both scenarios are unlikely to occur.

Query_Text_cn: 塞浦路斯对于整个欧元区来说并不重要；银行和各国政府的借贷成本几乎没有变化（见图表）。
Translation: Cyprus is not significant for the entire eurozone; the borrowing costs for banks and national governments have hardly changed (see chart).

Query_Text_cn: 但这场危机是让愤怒情绪浮至表面的又一个机会。
Translation: But this crisis is yet another opportunity for anger to surface.

Query_Text_cn: 有关欧元会破坏（而不是强化）欧洲团结的早已存在的担忧，似乎更有说服力了。
Translation: Longstanding concerns that the euro would undermine, rather than strengthen, European unity now seem more convincing.

Query_Text_cn: 这场危机还证明，即使留在欧元区的代价很高（这对很多塞浦路斯人来说肯定如此），债务人也愿意承受。
Translation: This crisis also demonstrates that, even when the cost of remaining in the eurozone is high (which is certainly the case for many Cypriots), debtors are still willing to bear it.

Query_Text_cn: 对债权人来说也是这样。
Translation: The same applies to creditors.

Query_Text_cn: 但出于经济和政治原因，他们宁可这么做，也不愿让欧元区破裂。
Translation: But for economic and political reasons, they would rather do this than allow the eurozone to break up.

Query_Text_cn: 于是，欧元区从一个危机踉跄走到另一个危机。
Translation: Thus, the eurozone has stumbled from one crisis to another.

Query_Text_cn: 我也说不准。
Translation: I can't say for sure either.

Query_Text_cn: 但我基本上可以确定，竞争性紧缩战略无法恢复欧元区的经济健康。
Translation: But I am fairly certain that competitive austerity strategies cannot restore economic health to the eurozone.

Query_Text_cn: 在看不到尽头的未来，它意味着欧元区经济整体虚弱，而相对更弱的经济体接二连三地爆发债务、银行业和失业危机。
Translation: In a future with no end in sight, this implies overall weakness in the eurozone economy, with relatively weaker economies experiencing successive crises in debt, banking, and unemployment.

Query_Text_cn: 与此同时，维持欧元区现状的意志极为强大。
Translation: Meanwhile, the determination to maintain the status quo in the Eurozone is extremely strong.

Query_Text_cn: 因此，这是一种不可抵挡的力量和不可动摇的目标之间的碰撞。
Translation: Therefore, this is a collision between an irresistible force and an immovable object.

Query_Text_cn: 塞浦路斯危机很小，在某种程度上也是一个漫长而痛苦的故事中一个不具代表性的章节。
Translation: The Cyprus crisis is relatively minor and, to some extent, represents an uncharacteristic chapter in a long and painful story.

Query_Text_cn: 我们离故事的最后一章还很远。
Translation: We are still far from the final chapter of the story.

Query_Text_cn: 印度工业信贷投资银行(ICICI)首席执行官昌达•科赫哈(ChandaKochhar)告诉英国《金融时报》，她的银行计划今年在上海开设首家完全分行，同时预计，随着印度各银行在未来十年寻求达到全球规模，该行业未来可能出现整合。
Translation: Chanda Kochhar, CEO of ICICI Bank, told the Financial Times that her bank plans to open its first full branch in Shanghai this year. She also expects that, as Indian banks seek to achieve global scale over the next decade, the industry may see consolidation in the future.

Query_Text_cn: 与此相反，前十名中就有四家中国的银行，包括高居榜首的中国工商银行(ICBC)，其市值大约是ICICI240亿美元估值的10倍。
Translation: In contrast, four Chinese banks are among the top ten, including the Industrial and Commercial Bank of China (ICBC), which ranks first with a market capitalization roughly ten times that of ICICI's $24 billion valuation.

Query_Text_cn: 继去年发行7.5亿美元国际债券后，ICICI将进一步发行外债。科赫哈补充说，ICICI计划未来几年让人寿保险和非人寿保险部门上市。
Translation: Following the issuance of US$750 million in international bonds last year, ICICI will further issue foreign debt. Kochhar added that ICICI plans to list its life insurance and non-life insurance divisions in the coming years.

Query_Text_cn: 她认为ICICI不太可能需要通过增发新股来满足巴塞尔协议III(BaselIII)的要求。
Translation: She believes that ICICI is unlikely to need to issue new shares to meet the requirements of Basel III.

Query_Text_cn: 交易所交易基金(ETF)彻底改变了黄金市场的面貌。
Translation: Exchange-traded funds (ETFs) have fundamentally transformed the landscape of the gold market.

Query_Text_cn: 如今，这个问题正困扰着黄金市场。
Translation: Today, this issue is troubling the gold market.

Query_Text_cn: 今年迄今，黄金ETF已累计抛出140吨黄金。
Translation: So far this year, gold ETFs have sold a total of 140 tons of gold.

Query_Text_cn: 2月份，黄金ETF的减仓量创下单月新高。
Translation: In February, the reduction in gold ETF holdings reached a record high for a single month.

Query_Text_cn: 这种抛售在一定程度上反映出，随着投资者对全球经济信心增强、并将资金投入股票等风险更高的资产，市场普遍看空黄金。
Translation: This sell-off to some extent reflects the prevailing bearish sentiment toward gold, as investors gain confidence in the global economy and shift their funds into higher-risk assets such as equities.

Query_Text_cn: 自去年10月以来，金价已累计下跌12%，目前已跌至每盎司1580美元以下，比2011年时创下的名义历史高点低18%。
Translation: Since October last year, the price of gold has fallen by a total of 12% and is now below $1,580 per ounce, 18% lower than its nominal historical peak in 2011.

Query_Text_cn: 但黄金ETF遭投资者抛售这件事本身，对黄金市场而言是令人担忧的。
Translation: However, the fact that gold ETFs are being sold off by investors is itself a cause for concern for the gold market.

Query_Text_cn: 之所以这么说，是因为黄金ETF已成为实物黄金市场的主要参与者之一。
Translation: The reason for this statement is that gold ETFs have become one of the main participants in the physical gold market.

Query_Text_cn: 自2003年首只黄金ETF在澳大利亚发行以来，这种产品取得了巨大的成功。
Translation: Since the launch of the first gold ETF in Australia in 2003, this product has achieved tremendous success.

Query_Text_cn: 它为投资者投资实物黄金提供了一种费用较低、交易起来比较容易的方式——由信托基金持有黄金，然后发行可在交易所交易的基金份额。
Translation: It provides investors with a low-cost and easily tradable way to invest in physical gold—gold is held by a trust fund, which then issues fund shares that can be traded on exchanges.

Query_Text_cn: 黄金ETF在世界各地持有的黄金共计2491吨左右，超过除美联储(Fed)和德国央行(Bundesbank)以外的所有央行。
Translation: Gold ETFs around the world hold approximately 2,491 tons of gold, surpassing all central banks except the Federal Reserve and the Bundesbank.

Query_Text_cn: 黄金ETF这波抛售之所以引起恐慌，还在于它来得出乎意料。
Translation: The panic triggered by this wave of gold ETF sell-offs stems from its unexpected nature.

Query_Text_cn: 此前若干次金价疲软的时期，黄金ETF投资者一直没有减仓。
Translation: During several previous periods of gold price weakness, investors in gold ETFs did not reduce their holdings.

Query_Text_cn: 例如，2011年最后两个月，金价曾下跌13%，但黄金ETF当时增持了黄金。
Translation: For example, in the last two months of 2011, the price of gold dropped by 13%, but gold ETFs increased their holdings during that period.

Query_Text_cn: 但在过去两个月里，黄金ETF的持有量随着金价下跌已有所减少。
Translation: However, over the past two months, holdings in gold ETFs have decreased as gold prices have fallen.

Query_Text_cn: 尽管减少的规模与总持有量相比相对较小，但这波抛售仍是历史上最大的一波抛售。
Translation: Although the scale of the reduction is relatively small compared to the total holdings, this wave of selling is still the largest in history.

Query_Text_cn: 通常而言，分析师假定黄金ETF的持有者为养老基金或保险公司等机构投资者，这些投资者已确定要把一部分资产配置为黄金。
Translation: Typically, analysts assume that holders of gold ETFs are institutional investors such as pension funds or insurance companies, who have already decided to allocate a portion of their assets to gold.

Query_Text_cn: 在美国，黄金ETF也受到散户的追捧。
Translation: In the United States, gold ETFs are also popular among retail investors.

Query_Text_cn: 分析师通常认为，这两种投资者都不会在金价刚出现下跌苗头时就马上抛售。
Translation: Analysts generally believe that neither type of investor is likely to sell off as soon as there are initial signs of a decline in gold prices.

Query_Text_cn: 然而，仍有人认为，黄金ETF这波抛售并不意味着投资者态度发生了根本性转变。
Translation: However, some still believe that the recent wave of gold ETF sell-offs does not signify a fundamental shift in investor sentiment.

Query_Text_cn: 事实上，一些交易员和投资者认为，这波抛售只反映出，有少数几只对冲基金在减持黄金。
Translation: In fact, some traders and investors believe that this wave of selling merely reflects the actions of a small number of hedge funds reducing their gold holdings.

Query_Text_cn: 这个观点得到期货和期权市场数据的支持，对冲基金在这两个市场上往往更加活跃。
Translation: This view is supported by data from the futures and options markets, where hedge funds tend to be more active.

Query_Text_cn: 美国商品期货交易委员会(CFTC)的数据显示，纽约商品期货交易所(Comex)黄金期货空头头寸的规模已升至十多年来的最高位。
Translation: Data from the U.S. Commodity Futures Trading Commission (CFTC) shows that the size of short positions in gold futures on the New York Commodity Exchange (Comex) has risen to its highest level in more than a decade.

Query_Text_cn: 但这种状况可能即将发生变化。
Translation: But this situation may be about to change.

Query_Text_cn: 中国证监会(CSRC)在郭树清主席领导下，过去一年来出台了一系列改善内地股市职能的措施。
Translation: Under the leadership of Chairman Guo Shuqing, the China Securities Regulatory Commission (CSRC) has introduced a series of measures over the past year to improve the functioning of the mainland stock market.

Query_Text_cn: 就在本月，证监会出台了使做空个股变得更容易的措施，增加了可投资股票期权的规模，扩大了可通过人民币合格境外机构投资者(RQFII)机制投资内地股市的投资者群体。
Translation: Earlier this month, the China Securities Regulatory Commission introduced measures to make short selling individual stocks easier, expanded the range of investable stock options, and broadened the pool of investors eligible to access the mainland stock market through the Renminbi Qualified Foreign Institutional Investor (RQFII) scheme.

Query_Text_cn: 总体而言，推出这些措施是为了鼓励更多国际资金进入中国市场，并平衡国内投资者侧重短线的操作手法。
Translation: Overall, the introduction of these measures aims to encourage more international capital to enter the Chinese market and to balance the short-term trading strategies favored by domestic investors.

Query_Text_cn: 中国当局认为，养老金、主权财富基金和资产管理基金等海外资金的进入可能会有利于改变这一状况，并因此启动了全球路演。
Translation: Chinese authorities believe that the entry of overseas funds such as pension funds, sovereign wealth funds, and asset management funds could help change this situation, and have therefore launched a global roadshow.

Query_Text_cn: 他们还降低了对希望取得投资A股牌照的机构的要求。
Translation: They have also lowered the requirements for institutions seeking to obtain licenses to invest in A-shares.

Query_Text_cn: 与指数供应商合作将可切实地扩大外资对中国内地市场的参与。
Translation: Collaborating with index providers can effectively expand foreign participation in the mainland Chinese market.

Query_Text_cn: 如果A股加入全球和地区基准股指，或者其权重增加，那么，那些跟踪由富时和摩根士丹利资本国际(MSCI)编制的指数的众多全球投资者，将被动地投资中国市场。
Translation: If A-shares are included in global and regional benchmark indices, or if their weighting increases, the numerous global investors tracking indices compiled by FTSE and MSCI will passively invest in the Chinese market.

Query_Text_cn: A股仅占富时全球指数的0.15%，占富时亚洲（除日本以外）基准指数的1.1%，占富时中国指数的6%。
Translation: A-shares account for only 0.15% of the FTSE Global Index, 1.1% of the FTSE Asia (excluding Japan) Benchmark Index, and 6% of the FTSE China Index.

Query_Text_cn: 假如不限制外资投资，这些数字将分别升至3.1%、19%和60%。
Translation: If there were no restrictions on foreign investment, these figures would rise to 3.1%, 19%, and 60%, respectively.

Query_Text_cn: 然而，一些人对于改革的时间存有疑虑。
Translation: However, some people have concerns about the timing of the reform.

Query_Text_cn: 全球投资者抱怨的不仅是准入门槛，还有公司治理、股东权益以及复杂的股权结构等问题。
Translation: Global investors are concerned not only about market access barriers but also about issues such as corporate governance, shareholder rights, and complex ownership structures.

Query_Text_cn: 然而，最大的挑战或许不在于准入，而是协调股东、管理层和政府的利益。
Translation: However, the greatest challenge may not lie in market access, but in aligning the interests of shareholders, management, and the government.

Query_Text_cn: 今年将是中国经济发展中具有重要里程碑意义的一年。
Translation: This year will be a milestone in China's economic development.

Query_Text_cn: 此前已出现过一个重要的转折点。
Translation: A significant turning point had already occurred.

Query_Text_cn: 因为服务业被视为增加消费的关键，所以很多人认为中国将跨过另一道门槛。
Translation: Because the service sector is regarded as key to boosting consumption, many believe China will cross another threshold.

Query_Text_cn: 该机构表示，2011年中国的最终消费对GDP增长的贡献率达51.6%，2012年为51.8%。
Translation: The agency stated that final consumption contributed 51.6% to China's GDP growth in 2011 and 51.8% in 2012.

Query_Text_cn: 人们都认为，中国经济只能选择可持续增长模式，即消费拉动模式。
Translation: It is widely believed that the only viable path for China's economy is to adopt a sustainable growth model driven by consumption.

Query_Text_cn: 观察家们认为，中国正在朝正确的方向转变。
Translation: Observers believe that China is moving in the right direction.

Query_Text_cn: 2011年，这一比例下降到了35%。
Translation: In 2011, this proportion dropped to 35%.

Query_Text_cn: 不管是批评者还是支持者，都注意到上个季度中国增长率有所提高。尽管眼下已出现增长乏力的迹象，但复苏却依然在继续。
Translation: Both critics and supporters have noted that China's growth rate increased last quarter. Although signs of sluggish growth have emerged, the recovery is still ongoing.

Query_Text_cn: 中国官员似乎并未对消费拉动型增长的说法提供佐证。
Translation: Chinese officials do not appear to have provided evidence to support the claim of consumption-driven growth.

Query_Text_cn: 这个数字甚至可能是比较保守的。
Translation: This figure may even be relatively conservative.

Query_Text_cn: 可能的情况是，政府支出项目为服务业带来的增长高于制造业，但所有这些支出都是明显不利于消费的。
Translation: It is possible that government spending projects have brought more growth to the service sector than to manufacturing, but all such spending is clearly detrimental to consumption.

Query_Text_cn: 这点之所以很重要，是因为一旦将拟制交易从数据中剔除，出口增长似乎就会不稳固，没有谁认为投资拉动型增长是可持续的。
Translation: This is particularly important because once fictitious transactions are excluded from the data, export growth appears unstable, and no one believes that investment-driven growth is sustainable.

Query_Text_cn: 这些不能成功的项目反过来又会生成债务。
Translation: These unsuccessful projects, in turn, generate debt.

Query_Text_cn: 因此，中国需要提高消费对增长的拉动作用。
Translation: Therefore, China needs to enhance the role of consumption in driving economic growth.

Query_Text_cn: 因此，中国处于一个新的超级周期，而这次则是下行周期。
Translation: Therefore, China is now in a new supercycle, but this time it is a downward cycle.

Query_Text_cn: 换言之，他们不再能够顺风而行；展望未来，他们将必须在逆境中取得成功。
Translation: In other words, they can no longer ride the tailwinds; looking ahead, they will have to succeed in the face of adversity.

Query_Text_cn: 因此，最近消费拉动型增长出现逆转，对中国而言是个相当严重的问题。
Translation: Therefore, the recent reversal of consumption-driven growth poses a rather serious problem for China.

Query_Text_cn: 有关中国经济的最大“不实之言”就是，服务业发展带来的消费增加，将成为今年中国经济增长的主要动力。
Translation: The biggest "misconception" about the Chinese economy is that the increase in consumption driven by the development of the service sector will be the main engine of China's economic growth this year.

Query_Text_cn: 不幸的是，事实可能正好相反。注：本文仅代表作者本人观点。
Translation: Unfortunately, the reality may be quite the opposite. Note: The views expressed in this article are solely those of the author.

Query_Text_cn: 4月27日，吉他(Jita)星系被一支舰队摧毁。这支舰队朝着任何试图穿越该星系的物体开火。
Translation: On April 27, the Jita star system was destroyed by a fleet. This fleet fired upon any object attempting to traverse the system.

Query_Text_cn: 吉他星系是矿石等原材料的重要贸易区，但在这一天，所有交通都被迫中止。
Translation: The Guitar Galaxy is an important trade zone for minerals and other raw materials, but on this day, all transportation was forced to cease.

Query_Text_cn: 这里描述的不是一部科幻电影的开场，而是游戏《星战前夜》(EveOnline)中玩家的活动。在这款游戏中，玩家能够采矿、制造物品、交易，甚至当海盗进行抢劫。
Translation: What is described here is not the opening scene of a science fiction movie, but the activities of players in the game "Eve Online." In this game, players can mine, manufacture items, trade, and even become pirates to carry out robberies.

Query_Text_cn: 出品这款游戏的冰岛CCP公司允许出现这样的破坏活动。
Translation: Iceland's CCP, the developer of this game, allows such destructive activities to take place.

Query_Text_cn: 葛德曼松曾任冰岛阿克雷里大学(UniversityofAkureyri)商业及科学系主任。他是最早受聘于游戏公司的经济学家之一，这些经济学家把他们在现实世界的专业知识应用到视频游戏中，因为游戏公司认识到，游戏中的交易体系就好像是微型经济体在运行一样。
Translation: Gudmundsson once served as the Head of the Faculty of Business and Science at the University of Akureyri in Iceland. He was among the first economists to be employed by gaming companies, applying their real-world expertise to video games, as these companies recognized that in-game trading systems function much like miniature economies.

Query_Text_cn: 他把自己在这个虚拟世界中掌管的研究与统计部比作一家央行。
Translation: He likens the research and statistics department he oversees in this virtual world to a central bank.

Query_Text_cn: 该部门监测游戏中的经济数据，报告并预测长期趋势。
Translation: The department monitors economic data within the game, reports and forecasts long-term trends.

Query_Text_cn: 瓦鲁法基斯(YanisVaroufakis)在美国游戏公司Valve担任着类似职务，他曾是希腊前总理乔治•帕潘德里欧(GeorgePapandreou)的顾问，在金融危机期间他的意见很吃香。
Translation: Yanis Varoufakis holds a similar position at the American gaming company Valve. He was once an advisor to former Greek Prime Minister George Papandreou, and his opinions were highly valued during the financial crisis.

Query_Text_cn: 当Valve公司在其游戏平台Steam上打造了一套交易平台，允许玩家购买和交易游戏及资产时，就出现了汇率和贸易赤字问题。
Translation: When Valve developed a trading platform on its Steam gaming platform, allowing players to purchase and trade games and assets, issues related to exchange rates and trade deficits emerged.

Query_Text_cn: 瓦鲁法基斯教授已不再担任常驻经济学家，但他仍在与Valve合作开发一款预测游戏。
Translation: Professor Varoufakis is no longer serving as the resident economist, but he is still collaborating with Valve to develop a prediction game.

Query_Text_cn: 这款游戏将让用户能够抓住视频游戏行业的发展趋势，预测哪款新游戏将会大热。
Translation: This game will enable users to grasp the development trends of the video game industry and predict which new games will become popular.

Query_Text_cn: 试图把虚拟经济和真实经济学研究联系起来的不只是游戏公司。
Translation: It is not only gaming companies that are attempting to link research on the virtual economy with that of the real economy.

Query_Text_cn: 瓦鲁法基斯教授指出，虚拟经济中的数据有一点额外优势，它们往往比现实世界的经济统计数据更加翔实、全面。
Translation: Professor Varoufakis pointed out that data in the virtual economy has an additional advantage: it is often more detailed and comprehensive than economic statistics in the real world.

Query_Text_cn: 卡斯特罗诺瓦教授认为，虚拟经济与经济学研究的联系将日益深化。
Translation: Professor Castronova believes that the connection between the virtual economy and economic research will become increasingly profound.

Query_Text_cn: 研究人们如何使用保险是普林斯顿大学(PrincetonUniversity)博士生尤哈•托尔瓦宁(JuhaTolvanen)使用《星战前夜》数据的一个方式。
Translation: Studying how people use insurance is one way Princeton University doctoral student Juha Tolvanen utilizes data from EVE Online.

Query_Text_cn: 游戏中的玩家可以为自己的太空飞船上保险，托尔瓦宁分析那些选择不购买额外保险的玩家会遇到哪些情况。
Translation: In the game, players can purchase insurance for their spaceships. Torvalainen analyzes the situations that players who choose not to buy additional insurance may encounter.

Query_Text_cn: 在针对现实生活中车辆保险的常规研究中，这种信息很难获得。
Translation: In conventional studies on vehicle insurance in real life, such information is difficult to obtain.

Query_Text_cn: 莱唐维塔表示，诸如此类的研究会揭示行为趋势，可以应用在现实生活中。
Translation: Laitang Weita stated that such studies reveal behavioral trends that can be applied in real life.

Query_Text_cn: 他更进一步指出，没有必要再去区分现实和虚拟之间的界限。
Translation: He further pointed out that there is no longer a need to distinguish between the boundaries of reality and the virtual.

Query_Text_cn: 同理，这些游戏环境代表这些微型经济体系。
Translation: Similarly, these gaming environments represent these microeconomic systems.

Query_Text_cn: 中国房地产股票昨日大跌，股市大盘出现28个月来最大单日跌幅，原因是政府出台了遏制房价反弹的严厉政策。
Translation: Chinese real estate stocks plummeted yesterday, and the broader stock market experienced its largest single-day decline in 28 months, due to the government's introduction of stringent policies to curb a rebound in housing prices.

Query_Text_cn: 中国政府去年曾成功引导房价企稳，但近几个月各大城市的房价又开始飙升。
Translation: The Chinese government successfully stabilized housing prices last year, but in recent months, prices in major cities have begun to surge again.

Query_Text_cn: 政府在最新宣布中要求，严格执行针对住房出售的20%的资本利得税，这条规则从2005年就开始生效，但迄今只得到零散的执行。
Translation: In its latest announcement, the government has called for strict enforcement of the 20% capital gains tax on housing sales—a regulation that has been in effect since 2005 but has so far only been sporadically implemented.

Query_Text_cn: 政府还表示，近期房价上涨过快的城市，应当采取针对性措施，包括提高抵押贷款的首付门槛，以及限制购买第二套住房。
Translation: The government also stated that cities experiencing rapid increases in housing prices should adopt targeted measures, including raising the minimum down payment for mortgages and restricting the purchase of second homes.

Query_Text_cn: 由上海和深圳证交所主要股票构成的沪深300(CSI300)指数下跌4.6%，这是自2010年11月以来最大单日跌幅。
Translation: The CSI 300 Index, which is composed mainly of stocks listed on the Shanghai and Shenzhen stock exchanges, fell by 4.6%, marking its largest single-day decline since November 2010.

Query_Text_cn: 各大开发商的股价下跌10%，这是中国允许的最大单日跌幅。
Translation: The share prices of major developers have fallen by 10%, which is the maximum single-day decline allowed in China.

Query_Text_cn: 不过，对于官方的最新努力能够产生多大效果，各方相当怀疑。
Translation: However, there is considerable skepticism among various parties regarding the effectiveness of the latest official efforts.

Query_Text_cn: 美银美林(BankofAmericaMerrillLynch)经济学家陆挺警告，资本利得税可能产生意外后果。
Translation: Lu Ting, an economist at Bank of America Merrill Lynch, has warned that a capital gains tax may lead to unintended consequences.

Query_Text_cn: 复旦大学房地产研究中心主任尹伯成表示，各城市会不会切实执行更严厉的政策也是一个问题。
Translation: Yin Bocheng, Director of the Real Estate Research Center at Fudan University, stated that whether cities will actually implement stricter policies remains an issue.

Query_Text_cn: 从12月第一周到2月底，沪深300指数上涨逾30%，房地产股票是表现最佳的板块之一。
Translation: From the first week of December to the end of February, the CSI 300 Index rose by more than 30%, with real estate stocks being one of the best-performing sectors.

Query_Text_cn: 那个数字将不只是中国的“果粉”关心的事情。
Translation: That figure will not be of concern only to China's "Apple fans."

Query_Text_cn: 它还将向我们揭示，在周日晚间协议宣布之前历时数月的谈判中，究竟哪一方占到了便宜。
Translation: It will also reveal which side gained the upper hand during the months-long negotiations prior to the announcement of the agreement on Sunday evening.

Query_Text_cn: 中国移动等运营商以往通常会同意补贴畅销机型的部分购机费用，但一些运营商眼下已开始尝试终结这种局面。
Translation: In the past, operators such as China Mobile typically agreed to subsidize part of the purchase cost for popular handset models, but some operators are now beginning to try to put an end to this practice.

Query_Text_cn: 一些分析人士警告称，进军4G业务和手机可能让中国移动付出高昂成本。中国移动已表示明年的补贴支出将高于今年的270亿元人民币（45亿美元），尽管高端手机销售业绩增长已放缓。
Translation: Some analysts have warned that venturing into 4G services and mobile phones may incur high costs for China Mobile. The company has stated that its subsidy expenditure next year will exceed this year's 27 billion yuan ($4.5 billion), despite the slowdown in sales growth of high-end smartphones.

Query_Text_cn: 在香港上市的中国移动股价昨日上扬0.8%。
Translation: China Mobile's share price, listed in Hong Kong, rose by 0.8% yesterday.

Query_Text_cn: 国有的中国移动把与苹果的经销协议视为对TD-LTE新技术标准的重要认可。
Translation: State-owned China Mobile regards its distribution agreement with Apple as a significant endorsement of the new TD-LTE technology standard.

Query_Text_cn: TD-LTE是中国移动4G新网络的核心，而国际上的4G运营商大部分使用FDD-LTE标准。
Translation: TD-LTE is the core of China Mobile's new 4G network, while most international 4G operators use the FDD-LTE standard.

Query_Text_cn: 除了没有与中国移动达成经销协议之外，苹果还将iPhone5c定价为4488元人民币，高于人们的预期。
Translation: In addition to not reaching a distribution agreement with China Mobile, Apple also priced the iPhone 5c at 4,488 yuan, which was higher than expected.

Query_Text_cn: 10月份最畅销的四款机型中有三款为iPhone。
Translation: Three out of the four best-selling models in October were iPhones.

Query_Text_cn: 中国移动表示，新的iPhone5s和5c将解决兼容性问题。
Translation: China Mobile stated that the new iPhone 5s and 5c will address compatibility issues.

Query_Text_cn: 中国巨额贸易顺差以及大量吸引外资的事实，都令经济学家认为，长期来看人民币将会升值。
Translation: China's massive trade surplus and its significant inflow of foreign investment have led economists to believe that, in the long run, the renminbi will appreciate.

Query_Text_cn: 然而中国央行(PBoC)依然在努力将人民币汇率向另一个方向引导。
Translation: However, the People's Bank of China (PBoC) is still striving to guide the renminbi exchange rate in the opposite direction.

Query_Text_cn: 中国央行每天早上会设定人民币兑美元汇率中间价，再对全天的人民币交易进行引导。今天，该行将人民币参考汇率下调了0.04%，定为1美元兑6.149元人民币。
Translation: China's central bank sets the daily midpoint for the yuan against the US dollar each morning to guide trading throughout the day. Today, the bank lowered the reference rate by 0.04%, setting it at 6.149 yuan per US dollar.

Query_Text_cn: 根据彭博(Bloomberg)的数据，这是6个月内的最低参考汇率。
Translation: According to Bloomberg data, this is the lowest reference exchange rate in six months.

Query_Text_cn: 人民币汇率随后进一步下跌，跌至1美元兑6.215元人民币。
Translation: The RMB exchange rate subsequently declined further, falling to 6.215 yuan per US dollar.

Query_Text_cn: 中国央行正在为人民币汇率制造一定的波动性，以阻止投机者的投机行为。这些投机者中许多都是中国人，他们不顾中国严格的资本控制将资金导入中国，以便从不断攀升的资产价格及人民币汇率的强劲增长中获利。
Translation: The People's Bank of China is deliberately creating some volatility in the renminbi exchange rate to deter speculative activity. Many of these speculators are Chinese nationals who, despite strict capital controls, channel funds into China to profit from soaring asset prices and the strong appreciation of the renminbi.

Query_Text_cn: 这一现象并不是头一次出现。
Translation: This phenomenon is not occurring for the first time.

Query_Text_cn: 2012年中国遭遇严重资金流入时，中国央行也曾开展过同样的操作。
Translation: When China faced significant capital inflows in 2012, the People's Bank of China also carried out similar operations.

Query_Text_cn: 不过，这一操作可能导致数十亿美元的真实财政损失。
Translation: However, this move could result in real fiscal losses amounting to billions of dollars.

Query_Text_cn: 中国内地和台湾许多企业都曾购买过押注人民币持续升值的对冲基金产品。
Translation: Many companies in mainland China and Taiwan have purchased hedge fund products betting on the continued appreciation of the renminbi.

Query_Text_cn: 许多这类名为“目标可赎回远期合约”(targetredemptionforward)的产品当人民币离岸汇率跌破1美元兑6.2元人民币时会出现巨额亏损，而人民币离岸汇率则是紧跟人民币国内市场汇率的。
Translation: Many products of this type, known as "target redemption forward" contracts, incur significant losses when the offshore RMB exchange rate falls below 6.2 yuan per US dollar, and the offshore RMB exchange rate closely follows the domestic RMB market rate.

Query_Text_cn: 目前，人民币离岸汇率正处于1美元兑6.2元人民币的水平。
Translation: Currently, the offshore RMB exchange rate is at the level of 6.2 yuan per US dollar.

Query_Text_cn: 在收购成瘾的孙正义(MasayoshiSon)领导下，日本电信集团软银(SoftBank)持有至少1300家公司的股份。
Translation: Under the acquisition-driven leadership of Masayoshi Son, Japanese telecommunications conglomerate SoftBank holds shares in at least 1,300 companies.

Query_Text_cn: 不过，这些都比不上2000年的那笔交易划算——那一年，孙正义拿出2000万美元，入股了当时羽翼未丰的中国电商企业阿里巴巴(Alibaba)。
Translation: However, none of these deals were as lucrative as the one in 2000, when Masayoshi Son invested $20 million in Alibaba, a fledgling Chinese e-commerce company at the time.

Query_Text_cn: 在阿里巴巴持有的股份只为软银带来了一小部分利润。根据软银的财报，在截至去年12月底的9个月中，阿里巴巴股份对软银净利润的贡献率还不到3%。
Translation: The shares held in Alibaba have brought only a small portion of profit to SoftBank. According to SoftBank's financial report, during the nine months ending last December, the contribution of Alibaba shares to SoftBank's net profit was less than 3%.

Query_Text_cn: 卖股所得资金最明显的去处是用于修复软银的资产负债表，毕竟软银在过去一年内完成了多笔交易。
Translation: The most obvious use of the proceeds from the share sales is to repair SoftBank's balance sheet, especially considering that SoftBank has completed several transactions over the past year.

Query_Text_cn: 其中最大的交易是去年斥资216亿美元收购Sprint，从而在美国电信业有了立足点。
Translation: The largest deal was the $21.6 billion acquisition of Sprint last year, which established a foothold in the U.S. telecommunications industry.

Query_Text_cn: 这些交易使软银的有息债务总额增加到8.8万亿日元以上，其净债务与EBITDA（息税折旧摊销前利润）之比从收购Sprint前的0.6增至如今的3.3。
Translation: These transactions have increased SoftBank's total interest-bearing debt to over 8.8 trillion yen, and its net debt-to-EBITDA ratio has risen from 0.6 before the acquisition of Sprint to 3.3 today.

Query_Text_cn: 孙正义还可用卖股所得资金为其在美国的扩张增添火力。
Translation: Masayoshi Son can also use the proceeds from stock sales to fuel his expansion in the United States.

Query_Text_cn: “软银集团正在投资于拥有出色技术或商业模式的公司，或与这些公司建立合资企业，以打造我们所说的战略协同集团。
Translation: SoftBank Group is investing in companies with outstanding technology or business models, or establishing joint ventures with them, to create what we call a strategically synergistic group.

Query_Text_cn: 中国移动是全球最大的移动通信服务提供商。该公司正在迅速扩大其4G移动网络，雄心勃勃地希望在今后几年覆盖中国大部分地区，这为设备制造商带来了利润丰厚的合同。
Translation: China Mobile is the world's largest mobile telecommunications service provider. The company is rapidly expanding its 4G mobile network, ambitiously aiming to cover most regions of China in the coming years, which presents lucrative contracts for equipment manufacturers.

Query_Text_cn: 尽管华为(Huawei)和中兴通讯(ZTE)等中国供应商得到超出比例的受益，但阿尔卡特、诺基亚西门子通信(NSN)和爱立信(Ericsson)等欧洲竞争对手全都承接了相关业务，为中国移动升级并提供设备和软件。
Translation: Although Chinese suppliers such as Huawei and ZTE benefited disproportionately, European competitors including Alcatel, Nokia Siemens Networks (NSN), and Ericsson also undertook related business, providing equipment and software for China Mobile's upgrade.

Query_Text_cn: 阿尔卡特-朗讯昨日表示，中国移动已选择该公司为其提供相关技术，使这家中国的移动运营商过渡到基于互联网的4G移动服务，让中国移动能够推出基于云的服务，并更容易地控制网络。
Translation: Alcatel-Lucent announced yesterday that China Mobile has selected the company to provide relevant technologies, enabling the Chinese mobile operator to transition to Internet-based 4G mobile services. This will allow China Mobile to launch cloud-based services and more easily control its network.

Query_Text_cn: 阿尔卡特-朗讯股价因该协议上涨逾5%。双方签署协议之际，正值中国国家主席习近平访问法国，纪念法中建交50周年。
Translation: Alcatel-Lucent's stock price rose by more than 5% following the agreement. The signing of the agreement coincided with Chinese President Xi Jinping's visit to France to commemorate the 50th anniversary of diplomatic relations between China and France.

Query_Text_cn: 阿尔卡特-朗讯在中国开展经营已有30年。
Translation: Alcatel-Lucent has been operating in China for 30 years.

Query_Text_cn: 不做空澳元只有一个站得住脚的理由：澳元不便宜。
Translation: There is only one valid reason not to short the Australian dollar: it is not cheap.

Query_Text_cn: 但同时看空澳元和澳大利亚经济的理由，却日益变得让人信服。
Translation: At the same time, the reasons for being bearish on the Australian dollar and the Australian economy are becoming increasingly convincing.

Query_Text_cn: 长期以来，澳大利亚一直因盛产煤炭、铁矿石和液化天然气(LNG)而闻名，由于中国对其资源的需求，这一名声甚至比作为“流着牛奶和蜂蜜的土地”对该国更有利。
Translation: Australia has long been renowned for its abundant coal, iron ore, and liquefied natural gas (LNG), and thanks to China's demand for these resources, this reputation has proven even more advantageous for the country than being known as "a land flowing with milk and honey."

Query_Text_cn: 澳大利亚逃过了15年前的亚洲金融危机和5年前的全球金融危机。
Translation: Australia escaped both the Asian financial crisis 15 years ago and the global financial crisis 5 years ago.

Query_Text_cn: 但去年该国经济增长率仅为2.4%。
Translation: However, the country's economic growth rate was only 2.4% last year.

Query_Text_cn: 未来，这个“幸运国度”或许就不会有过去20年那样的好运了。
Translation: In the future, this "lucky nation" may no longer enjoy the same good fortune it has had over the past 20 years.

Query_Text_cn: 汇丰数据显示，2014年1-2月，中国工业产出增幅降至近5年最低水平。
Translation: HSBC data shows that in January and February 2014, China's industrial output growth fell to its lowest level in nearly five years.

Query_Text_cn: 澳大利亚虽不属新兴国家之列，但中国增长放缓对其冲击非常巨大，一道遭殃的还有印尼、巴西、智利和秘鲁。
Translation: Although Australia is not classified as an emerging country, the slowdown in China's growth has had a significant impact on it, affecting Indonesia, Brazil, Chile, and Peru as well.

Query_Text_cn: 近来，一家持有300亿美元中国股票组合的亚洲主权财富基金的一名高管，向香港一家大型对冲基金的经理寻求建议，询问在中国内地增长放缓的背景下，应当如何对冲其中国股票组合的风险。
Translation: Recently, an executive from an Asian sovereign wealth fund holding a $30 billion portfolio of Chinese equities sought advice from the manager of a major hedge fund in Hong Kong, asking how to hedge the risks of its Chinese stock holdings amid slowing growth in mainland China.

Query_Text_cn: 对方回答：做空澳元。
Translation: Short the Australian dollar.

Query_Text_cn: 如今，澳元已成为十国集团(G10)货币中对中国风险敞口最大的币种。
Translation: Today, the Australian dollar has become the G10 currency with the largest exposure to China-related risks.

Query_Text_cn: 而在油价高企的同时，澳大利亚大宗商品的价格却遭遇下行压力，导致经济基本面日益恶化。
Translation: Meanwhile, while oil prices remain high, the prices of Australia's commodities are facing downward pressure, leading to a worsening of the country's economic fundamentals.

Query_Text_cn: 2013年，资本支出对澳大利亚国内生产总值(GDP)的贡献为负值，预计2014年仍将为负值。
Translation: In 2013, capital expenditure made a negative contribution to Australia's Gross Domestic Product (GDP), and it is expected to remain negative in 2014.

Query_Text_cn: 但一切费用都很高，技能熟练的劳动力严重不足，以致有知情人士表示，当这三个项目完工之后，柏克德在澳大利亚就不可能有太多事做了。
Translation: However, all costs are very high and there is a severe shortage of skilled labor, to the extent that informed sources have indicated that once these three projects are completed, there will be little left for Bechtel to do in Australia.

Query_Text_cn: 摩根大通数据显示，澳大利亚仅去年便取消了价值逾1100亿澳元的资源相关项目。
Translation: According to data from JPMorgan, Australia canceled resource-related projects worth more than AUD 110 billion last year alone.

Query_Text_cn: 制造业将无法抵消矿业疲软的影响。
Translation: The manufacturing sector will not be able to offset the impact of weakness in the mining industry.

Query_Text_cn: 调查显示，澳大利亚企业并不愿意在非矿业行业增加支出。
Translation: Surveys indicate that Australian businesses are reluctant to increase spending in non-mining sectors.

Query_Text_cn: 丰田(Toyota)是最近一家宣布将停止在澳大利亚生产汽车的汽车公司。
Translation: Toyota is the latest automaker to announce it will cease manufacturing cars in Australia.

Query_Text_cn: 同时，身在香港，很容易感觉到中国经济放缓的真实可能性引发的矛盾情绪。
Translation: At the same time, living in Hong Kong, one can easily sense the conflicting emotions triggered by the real possibility of a slowdown in China's economy.

Query_Text_cn: 倘若中国增长放缓，香港甚至将比澳大利亚更不堪一击。
Translation: If China's growth slows, Hong Kong could be even more vulnerable than Australia.

Query_Text_cn: 随着人民币一路升值，香港居民长期以来一直在当地和内地同时保有人民币账户，享受到了比美元或港元账户更高的利率收益。
Translation: As the renminbi continues to appreciate, Hong Kong residents have long maintained renminbi accounts both locally and on the mainland, enjoying higher interest returns than those offered by US dollar or Hong Kong dollar accounts.

Query_Text_cn: 如果这一趋势延续下去，要对冲大规模中国股票组合的风险，做空人民币比做空澳元更有效，而且成本要低得多。
Translation: If this trend continues, shorting the renminbi will be more effective and much less costly than shorting the Australian dollar when it comes to hedging the risks of a large-scale Chinese equity portfolio.

Query_Text_cn: 北京当局已成功实现为人民币汇率轨迹注入不确定性的目标。
Translation: Beijing authorities have successfully achieved their goal of injecting uncertainty into the trajectory of the renminbi exchange rate.

Query_Text_cn: 遗憾的是，到底什么是无风险赌局，再也不是确定无疑的了。
Translation: Regrettably, what exactly constitutes a risk-free bet is no longer a matter of certainty.

Query_Text_cn: 中国经济的前景如何？当前没有几个经济问题（如果有的话）能比这个问题更重要。
Translation: What is the outlook for China's economy? At present, there are few—if any—economic questions more important than this one.

Query_Text_cn: 外界对中国这位巨人维持快速增长的能力越来越悲观。
Translation: There is growing pessimism about China's ability to sustain rapid growth as a giant.

Query_Text_cn: 人们的担心主要集中在产能过剩、过度投资和债务负担沉重三个方面。
Translation: People's concerns are mainly focused on three areas: overcapacity, excessive investment, and heavy debt burdens.

Query_Text_cn: 我也认为，即使以中国已经成功应对的挑战为标杆，转向增速较慢、但更加平衡的经济增长也是一项异常艰巨的考验。
Translation: I also believe that, even when measured against the challenges China has already successfully addressed, shifting toward slower but more balanced economic growth remains an exceptionally daunting task.

Query_Text_cn: 然而迄今的事实证明，打赌中国的政策制定者不会成功是愚蠢的赌注。
Translation: However, facts so far have proven that betting against the success of China's policymakers is a foolish gamble.

Query_Text_cn: 当一匹良马遇到一道新的障碍，马的胜算肯定会大一些。
Translation: When a fine horse encounters a new obstacle, its chances of winning are certainly higher.

Query_Text_cn: 但就算最优秀的马也可能被绊倒。
Translation: But even the finest horse may stumble.

Query_Text_cn: 首先，中国已经是一个中等偏上收入国家，人均国内生产总值(GDP)已达6700美元。
Translation: First, China is already an upper-middle-income country, with a per capita GDP of $6,700.

Query_Text_cn: 中国正开始向成为一个发达经济体努力，史上完成这项任务的国家不多。
Translation: China is beginning to strive toward becoming a developed economy, a feat achieved by only a few countries in history.

Query_Text_cn: 其次，国际环境已不如以往有利，部分原因是高收入经济体在结构上如此疲弱，还有部分原因是中国经济相对于其他经济体已显著变大了。
Translation: Secondly, the international environment is no longer as favorable as it once was, partly due to the structural weakness of high-income economies and partly because the Chinese economy has grown significantly larger relative to other economies.

Query_Text_cn: 第三，中国经济自身发生变化。
Translation: Third, changes have occurred within China's own economy.

Query_Text_cn: 潜在增长率已下降至7%-8%，原因包括劳动适龄人口减少；产能过剩即使按中国的标准来衡量也变得十分严重；金融风险有所上升，其推动因素是地方政府债务、房产泡沫和影子银行业的增长；中国的城市化程度已超过50%，可它的城市遭受着一系列弊病，包括污染问题。
Translation: The potential growth rate has declined to 7%-8% due to several factors, including a decrease in the working-age population; overcapacity has become extremely severe, even by Chinese standards; financial risks have risen, driven by local government debt, the real estate bubble, and the growth of the shadow banking sector; China's urbanization rate has surpassed 50%, yet its cities are plagued by a range of problems, including pollution.

Query_Text_cn: 最后，资源密集型增长模式已触及极限，尤其是水资源，这种资源不是可直接交易的大宗商品。
Translation: Finally, the resource-intensive growth model has reached its limits, especially with regard to water resources, which are not directly tradable commodities.

Query_Text_cn: 这些都是西方人所熟悉的。
Translation: These are all familiar to Westerners.

Query_Text_cn: 这意味着国有企业的角色要发生变化。
Translation: This means that the role of state-owned enterprises will need to change.

Query_Text_cn: 它还意味着新进入者在能够开展哪些业务的问题上将面对“负面清单”，而不是“正面清单”：企业将可以从事任何没有被禁止的经营活动，而不再需要审批。
Translation: It also means that new entrants will face a "negative list" rather than a "positive list" regarding the types of businesses they can engage in: enterprises will be allowed to conduct any business activities that are not explicitly prohibited, without the need for approval.

Query_Text_cn: 户籍制度改革也是此轮改革的重点之一，它将允许1亿农业转移人口获得城镇永久居住资格。
Translation: Reform of the household registration system is also one of the key focuses of this round of reforms, which will allow 100 million rural migrants to obtain permanent urban residency.

Query_Text_cn: 对于多数局外人来说，政府公告的语言令人头脑发木。
Translation: For most outsiders, the language used in government announcements is mind-numbing.

Query_Text_cn: 不过，在听了李克强总理和张高丽副总理的发言后，我认为这一切至少在逻辑上是令人信服的。
Translation: However, after listening to the speeches by Premier Li Keqiang and Vice Premier Zhang Gaoli, I believe that all of this is at least logically convincing.

Query_Text_cn: 他们显然已认识到，需要采取果断行动来应对国家面临的挑战。
Translation: They have clearly recognized the need to take decisive action to address the challenges facing the country.

Query_Text_cn: 他们想做的事在经济和环境两方面都很有道理。
Translation: What they intend to do makes sense both economically and environmentally.

Query_Text_cn: 一份关于中国中期经济前景的背景文件，以及现执教于耶鲁大学(Yale)的斯蒂芬?罗奇(StephenRoach)的报告表明，中国在转变经济增长模式方面也取得了切实进展：中国力图转向速度较慢、资源密集度较低、就业密集度较高的经济增长模式。
Translation: A background paper on China's medium-term economic outlook, as well as a report by Stephen Roach, currently teaching at Yale University, indicate that China has also made tangible progress in transforming its economic growth model: the country is striving to shift toward a slower-paced, less resource-intensive, and more employment-intensive pattern of economic growth.

Query_Text_cn: 2008年前，经济每增长1个百分点所创造的城镇新增就业数不到100万。
Translation: Before 2008, each 1-percentage-point increase in economic growth created fewer than one million new urban jobs.

Query_Text_cn: 2008年以来，这一数字平均达到140万。
Translation: Since 2008, this figure has averaged 1.4 million.

Query_Text_cn: 通胀水平一直很好地处于可控范围，工业盈利能力在经济放缓期间保持得较好。
Translation: The inflation level has remained well within a controllable range, and industrial profitability has been maintained relatively well during the economic slowdown.

Query_Text_cn: 总体而言，中国经济似乎在平稳地调整，逐渐适应不可避免的减速，其推动因素是利用未开发资源（包括劳动力）的能力不断下降。
Translation: Overall, the Chinese economy appears to be adjusting smoothly, gradually adapting to the inevitable slowdown, driven by the diminishing capacity to leverage untapped resources, including labor.

Query_Text_cn: 不过，中国经济依然高度失衡，其最显著的特征是消费（包括公共和个人消费）占经济的比重异常低，而投资的比重异常高（两者都接近GDP的一半）。
Translation: However, the Chinese economy remains highly unbalanced, with its most notable feature being the exceptionally low share of consumption (including both public and private consumption) in the economy, while the share of investment is unusually high—both accounting for nearly half of GDP.

Query_Text_cn: 这种情况直到去年才稍稍有所逆转，此前投资所占比重一直快速上升，自本世纪初以来几乎一直保持这个势头。
Translation: This situation only began to reverse slightly last year; prior to that, the proportion of investment had been rising rapidly and had maintained this momentum almost continuously since the beginning of this century.

Query_Text_cn: 目前，个人消费占GDP的比重约为35%，大致只有美国的一半。
Translation: Currently, personal consumption accounts for about 35% of GDP, roughly half that of the United States.

Query_Text_cn: 超高的投资比重推动了经济增长。
Translation: The exceptionally high investment ratio has driven economic growth.

Query_Text_cn: 但也与过剩产能的增长和杠杆率的上升直接相关。
Translation: But it is also directly related to the growth of excess capacity and the rise in leverage ratios.

Query_Text_cn: 正如那份中期前景文件所指出的，中国经济表现所面对的风险潜藏于金融恐慌、房地产泡沫破裂、地方政府高负债和产能过剩等相关风险。
Translation: As noted in the medium-term outlook document, the risks facing China's economic performance are rooted in related issues such as financial panic, the bursting of the real estate bubble, high local government debt, and excess capacity.

Query_Text_cn: 危险在于，迅速纠正这些问题可能引发一个正反馈循环，导致一轮远比预期剧烈的经济减速。
Translation: The danger is that swiftly addressing these issues could trigger a positive feedback loop, resulting in an economic slowdown that is far more severe than anticipated.

Query_Text_cn: 许多重要行业的产出已降至产能的75%以下。
Translation: Output in many key industries has fallen below 75% of capacity.

Query_Text_cn: 然而中国经济规模已太过庞大，无法通过出口来摆脱这一困境。
Translation: However, China's economy is now too large to overcome this predicament through exports.

Query_Text_cn: 以钢铁为例，中国钢铁业的年产能为10亿吨，产出7.2亿吨，占全球钢铁总产量的46%。
Translation: Taking steel as an example, China's steel industry has an annual production capacity of 1 billion tons and an output of 720 million tons, accounting for 46% of the world's total steel production.

Query_Text_cn: 如果对基础设施和房地产的投资大幅降低，那么钢铁业的产能利用率将受到沉重打击。
Translation: If investment in infrastructure and real estate drops sharply, the capacity utilization rate of the steel industry will be severely impacted.

Query_Text_cn: 对水泥业来说同样如此。
Translation: The same applies to the cement industry.

Query_Text_cn: 坏账将会飙升。
Translation: Bad debts will soar.

Query_Text_cn: 有些人可能提出，中国经济需要的正是一场硬着陆。
Translation: Some may argue that what the Chinese economy needs is precisely a hard landing.

Query_Text_cn: 对此，政府不会同意，我也一样（当然我的意见无关紧要）。
Translation: The government will not agree to this, nor will I (though, of course, my opinion is of little consequence).

Query_Text_cn: 中国政府还有许多调控手段可以利用。
Translation: The Chinese government still has many regulatory tools at its disposal.

Query_Text_cn: 不过，金融压力和宏观调整的下行风险已在急剧上升。
Translation: However, financial pressures and downside risks from macroeconomic adjustments have been rising sharply.

Query_Text_cn: 我将在下周评估这些风险的规模，并给出可能的对策。
Translation: I will assess the magnitude of these risks next week and provide possible countermeasures.

Query_Text_cn: 数百名储户争相从中国东部一家小型农村银行取钱，迫使当地官员在挤兑开始蔓延后采取紧急措施，以平息恐慌
Translation: Hundreds of depositors rushed to withdraw their money from a small rural bank in eastern China, forcing local officials to take emergency measures to calm the panic after the bank run began to spread.

Query_Text_cn: 据官方媒体报道，在有传言称江苏射阳农村商业银行濒临倒闭后，忧心忡忡的储户纷纷涌向该银行
Translation: According to official media reports, after rumors spread that Jiangsu Sheyang Rural Commercial Bank was on the verge of bankruptcy, anxious depositors flocked to the bank.

Query_Text_cn: 据新华社报道，周二，在射阳县至少另外三个村庄的分行外，存款人排起了长队。
Translation: According to Xinhua News Agency, on Tuesday, depositors formed long queues outside branches in at least three other villages in Sheyang County.

Query_Text_cn: 江苏射阳农村商业银行采取了一系列措施安抚储户。
Translation: Jiangsu Sheyang Rural Commercial Bank has taken a series of measures to reassure depositors.

Query_Text_cn: 有照片显示，该行准备了大量成捆的人民币以应对储户提款要求。。
Translation: Photos show that the bank has prepared a large amount of bundled RMB to meet depositors' withdrawal demands.

Query_Text_cn: 在一家受灾支行外的点阵标志上，该行承诺24小时不间断运营，为人们提供取款服务。
Translation: On the LED sign outside a disaster-affected branch, the bank pledged to operate 24 hours a day without interruption, providing withdrawal services to the public.

Query_Text_cn: 在一家受灾支行外的点阵标志上，该行承诺24小时不间断运营，为人们提供取款服务。
Translation: On the LED sign outside a disaster-affected branch, the bank pledged to operate around the clock, providing uninterrupted withdrawal services to the public.

Query_Text_cn: 然而这些举措并未减轻人们的担忧各位储户不要听信谣言，造成不必要的恐慌。
Translation: However, these measures have not alleviated public concerns. Depositors are advised not to believe in rumors and cause unnecessary panic.

Query_Text_cn: 周二整整一天，这家分行门外都聚集着冒雨提取现金的人群。。
Translation: All day on Tuesday, crowds of people braved the rain to withdraw cash outside the branch.

Query_Text_cn: 随着恐慌蔓延到该银行的其他分支机构，政府于周三进行了干预
Translation: As panic spread to other branches of the bank, the government intervened on Wednesday.

Query_Text_cn: 今年早些时候，射阳县几家信贷合作社和贷款担保公司突然倒闭，导致至少8000万人民币资金蒸发。
Translation: Earlier this year, several credit cooperatives and loan guarantee companies in Sheyang County suddenly collapsed, resulting in the disappearance of at least 80 million yuan in funds.

Query_Text_cn: 这类机构在运营过程中并未受到和银行一样严格的监管。据当地媒体报道，这几家机构的负责人在投资出现大量亏损后出逃。
Translation: These institutions are not subject to the same stringent regulations as banks during their operations. According to local media reports, the heads of these institutions fled after incurring significant investment losses.

Query_Text_cn: 江苏射阳农村商业银行董事长臧正志将此次挤兑归咎于此前这些银行倒闭引发的担忧 。
Translation: Zang Zhengzhi, chairman of Jiangsu Sheyang Rural Commercial Bank, attributed the recent bank run to concerns triggered by the earlier collapses of these banks.

Query_Text_cn: 当地警方表示，他们将调查谣言的来源。
Translation: Local police stated that they will investigate the source of the rumors.

Query_Text_cn: 中国监管机构预计将在未来几个月披露一项存款保险计划。
Translation: Chinese regulators are expected to unveil a deposit insurance scheme in the coming months.

Query_Text_cn: 但与此同时，银行存款只得到政府的隐性担保 。
Translation: At the same time, however, bank deposits receive only implicit government guarantees.

Query_Text_cn: 从系统风险的角度看，江苏射阳农村商业银行规模很小。
Translation: From the perspective of systemic risk, Jiangsu Sheyang Rural Commercial Bank is very small in scale.

Query_Text_cn: 截至2月底，该行管理的存款规模为120亿元人民币，约占中国银行体系总资产的0.01% 。
Translation: As of the end of February, the bank managed deposits totaling 12 billion yuan, accounting for approximately 0.01% of the total assets in China's banking system.

Query_Text_cn: 多年来，印度人一直希望能凭借自己的优点最终超过中国。
Translation: For years, Indians have hoped to surpass China based on their own merits.

Query_Text_cn: 他们的国家或许会步履蹒跚，但其前进的方向是正确的
Translation: Their country may stumble, but it is moving in the right direction.

Query_Text_cn: 中国有能力实现年复一年10%的经济增长，尽管就连这个奇迹最近也走到了尽头。
Translation: China has the capacity to achieve year-on-year economic growth of 10%, although even this miracle has recently come to an end.

Query_Text_cn: 中国只有一个油门踏板
Translation: China has only one accelerator pedal.
