Translation: These changes are driven by a variety of factors, some of which are structural, while others are more specific and historical.

Query_Text_cn: 经济影响尤其是全球金融系统当然是其中的推动力。
Translation: Economic impact, particularly on the global financial system, is certainly one of the driving forces.

Query_Text_cn: 然而，它们与自然力量不同。
Translation: However, they are different from the forces of nature.

Query_Text_cn: 它们受到技术、文化传播以及政府解放并对其国家经济解除管制的决定等的影响。
Translation: They are influenced by technology, cultural dissemination, and decisions by governments to liberalize and deregulate their national economies.

Query_Text_cn: 苏联的解体更进一步加深了这些发展的作用，因为再也没有一个重要的国家集团处在全球化范围的外面了。
Translation: The dissolution of the Soviet Union further deepened the impact of these developments, as there was no longer any major bloc of countries remaining outside the scope of globalization.

Query_Text_cn: 它的解体并不是偶然发生的。
Translation: Its dissolution did not occur by chance.

Query_Text_cn: 全球化解释了苏联为什么会以及如何走向它的终结的。
Translation: Globalization explains why and how the Soviet Union moved toward its eventual demise.

Query_Text_cn: 前苏联和东欧国家在增长率方面是直到20世纪70年代早期才可与西方相比较的。
Translation: The former Soviet Union and Eastern European countries were comparable to the West in terms of growth rates only until the early 1970s.

Query_Text_cn: 苏联解体以后，他们很快落在了后面。
Translation: After the dissolution of the Soviet Union, they quickly fell behind.

Query_Text_cn: 苏联共产主义模式因其过分重视国营企业与重工业，无法在全球电子经济中参与竞争。此外，共产主义政权赖以存在的意识形态与文化控制，在全球媒体时代同样难以维系。
Translation: The Soviet communist model, due to its excessive emphasis on state-owned enterprises and heavy industry, was unable to compete in the global electronic economy. Moreover, the ideological and cultural control on which communist regimes depended for their existence became equally unsustainable in the era of global media.

Query_Text_cn: 苏联和东欧政权无法阻止人们对西方广播和电视的接收。
Translation: The Soviet Union and Eastern European regimes were unable to prevent people from receiving Western radio and television broadcasts.

Query_Text_cn: 电视在1989年革命中起着直接的作用，这次革命被人们恰当地称为第一次“电视革命”。
Translation: Television played a direct role in the 1989 revolution, which has rightly been called the first "television revolution."

Query_Text_cn: 发生在一个国家的街头抗议被其他国家的电视观众所观看，然后他们自己也会走上街头。
Translation: Street protests occurring in one country are watched by television audiences in other countries, who may then take to the streets themselves.

Query_Text_cn: 当然，全球化并不以公平的方式发展，而且它所带来的结果绝对不是完全良性的。
Translation: Of course, globalization does not develop in a fair manner, and the outcomes it brings are by no means entirely positive.

Query_Text_cn: 对许多生活在欧洲和北美洲以外的人来说，全球化似乎就是西化或者美国化，因为美国现在是惟一的超级大国，在全球秩序中占据主导的经济、文化和军事位置。
Translation: For many people living outside Europe and North America, globalization appears to be synonymous with Westernization or Americanization, as the United States is currently the sole superpower, occupying a dominant economic, cultural, and military position in the global order.

Query_Text_cn: 在全球化的最显而易见的文化体现中，许多都是美国的，如，可口可乐、麦当劳和美国有线新闻等。
Translation: Among the most obvious cultural manifestations of globalization, many are American, such as Coca-Cola, McDonald's, and CNN.

Query_Text_cn: 大部分大型跨国公司也都建立在美国。
Translation: Most large multinational corporations are also headquartered in the United States.

Query_Text_cn: 而那些（非美国的大型跨国公司）也全都来自富裕国家，而非世界上较贫困的地区。
Translation: And those (large multinational corporations outside the United States) also all come from wealthy countries, rather than from the poorer regions of the world.

Query_Text_cn: 对全球化持悲观态度的人会认为，全球化在很大程度上是工业发达的 “北方国家” 的事务 —— 在这一进程中，南部的发展中国家几乎无法发挥积极作用，甚至完全无法参与。
Translation: Those who hold a pessimistic view of globalization believe that it is largely an affair of the industrialized "Northern countries"—in this process, developing countries in the South can hardly play an active role, or may even be entirely excluded.

Query_Text_cn: 这可以看作是破坏了地区文化、扩大了世界不平等并且恶化了许多穷困地区的状况。
Translation: This can be seen as undermining regional cultures, exacerbating global inequality, and worsening the conditions in many impoverished areas.

Query_Text_cn: 有些人认为，全球化创造了许多胜者和败者,有些人暴富了起来，而大多数人陷人了悲惨绝望的生活中。
Translation: Some people believe that globalization has created many winners and losers; while some have become extremely wealthy, the majority have fallen into lives of misery and despair.

Query_Text_cn: 的确，统计数字令人非常沮丧。
Translation: Indeed, the statistics are deeply discouraging.

Query_Text_cn: 从1989年至1998年之间，全世界最穷的1/5的人口占全球收入的份额已经从2.3%下降到14%。
Translation: Between 1989 and 1998, the share of global income held by the poorest fifth of the world's population decreased from 2.3% to 1.4%.

Query_Text_cn: 另一方面，最富的1/5人口所占的比例却上升了。
Translation: On the other hand, the proportion of the richest one-fifth of the population has increased.

Query_Text_cn: 在撒哈拉南部非洲，20个国家人均收人比20世纪70年代晚期还要低。
Translation: In sub-Saharan Africa, the per capita income in 20 countries is lower than it was in the late 1970s.

Query_Text_cn: 在许多欠发达国家，安全设备和环境规则很少或者几乎就不存在。
Translation: In many underdeveloped countries, safety equipment and environmental regulations are scarce or virtually nonexistent.

Query_Text_cn: 一些跨国公司在那里销售在工业国家中被控制或者被禁止销售的商品，如劣质药品、破坏性的杀虫剂和焦油及尼古丁含量高的香烟等。
Translation: Some multinational corporations sell products there that are regulated or banned in industrialized countries, such as substandard medicines, harmful pesticides, and cigarettes with high tar and nicotine content.

Query_Text_cn: 人们可能会说，这不是一个地球村，而更像是全球掠夺。
Translation: Some might say that this is not a global village, but rather global plunder.

Query_Text_cn: 不断扩大的不平等加上与之相关的生态环境危险是全世界社会面临的最严重的问题。
Translation: The ever-widening inequality, coupled with the associated ecological risks, constitutes the most serious challenge facing societies worldwide.

Query_Text_cn: 然而，这不能只归罪于富人。
Translation: However, this cannot be attributed solely to the wealthy.

Query_Text_cn: 我基本上认为，今天的全球化只是一定程度上的西化。
Translation: I basically believe that today's globalization is, to a certain extent, merely Westernization.

Query_Text_cn: 与较穷的国家相比较，西方国家以及更笼统地说的工业国家当然仍然对全世界事务产生的影响要大得多。
Translation: Compared with poorer countries, Western nations—and more broadly, industrialized countries—still exert a much greater influence on global affairs.

Query_Text_cn: 但是，全球化正变得越来越无中心化，不受任何国家集团的控制，也很少受大公司的控制。
Translation: However, globalization is becoming increasingly decentralized, not controlled by any group of countries and rarely dominated by large corporations.

Query_Text_cn: 全球化所带来的影响在西方国家和在其他地方感觉差不多。
Translation: The impact of globalization is felt similarly in Western countries and elsewhere.

Query_Text_cn: 对于影响政府本身性质的全球金融系统及社会变迁来说，情况的确如此。
Translation: This is indeed the case when it comes to the global financial system and social changes that affect the very nature of government itself.

Query_Text_cn: 所谓的“反殖民化”正变得越来越普遍。反殖民化意味着非西方国家对西方的发展产生影响。
Translation: The so-called "decolonization" is becoming increasingly prevalent. Decolonization means that non-Western countries are exerting influence on the development of the West.

Query_Text_cn: 这样的例子非常多，如洛杉矶的拉丁化、印度的全球取向的高技术区的出现以及巴西电视节目卖给葡萄牙等。
Translation: There are numerous such examples, such as the Latinization of Los Angeles, the emergence of globally oriented high-tech zones in India, and Brazilian television programs being sold to Portugal.

Query_Text_cn: 考虑到这个现象的复杂性，这个问题不能简单地来回答。
Translation: Given the complexity of this phenomenon, this question cannot be answered simply.

Query_Text_cn: 问这个问题的人以及认为全球化导致世界不平等不断加深的人通常是从经济全球化以及自由贸易的角度来考虑的。
Translation: People who ask this question, as well as those who believe that globalization has deepened global inequality, usually approach the issue from the perspective of economic globalization and free trade.

Query_Text_cn: 现在，自由贸易明显不是一种纯粹的利益。
Translation: At present, free trade is clearly not a purely beneficial arrangement.

Query_Text_cn: 当它涉及欠发达国家时尤其如此。
Translation: This is especially true when it comes to underdeveloped countries.

Query_Text_cn: 一个国家或者某些地区开放进行自由贸易会削弱当地的生存经济。
Translation: The opening of a country or certain regions to free trade can undermine the subsistence economy of the local area.

Query_Text_cn: 一个只依靠少数产品在世界市场上销售的地区非常容易受到价格变动以及技术变革的冲击。
Translation: A region that relies on the sale of only a few products in the world market is highly vulnerable to price fluctuations and technological changes.

Query_Text_cn: 贸易总是需要一套制度框架，其他形式的经济发展也是如此。
Translation: Trade always requires an institutional framework, as do other forms of economic development.

Query_Text_cn: 市场不能只依靠纯粹的经济手段来建立，某种经济到底在多大程度上向世界市场开放必定取决于许多标准。
Translation: Markets cannot be established solely through purely economic means; the extent to which a particular economy opens up to the world market inevitably depends on a variety of criteria.

Query_Text_cn: 然而，反对经济全球化而选择经济保护主义对于富裕国家和穷困国家来说同样都是一个错误的策略。
Translation: However, opposing economic globalization and opting for economic protectionism is a misguided strategy for both wealthy and impoverished countries alike.

Query_Text_cn: 保护主义在某些时候和在某些国家可能是一种必需的策略。
Translation: Protectionism may be a necessary strategy at certain times and in certain countries.

Query_Text_cn: 例如，我认为，马来西亚在1998年引人控制手段阻止资金大量外流就是正确的。
Translation: For example, I believe it was correct for Malaysia to introduce control measures in 1998 to prevent large-scale capital outflows.

Query_Text_cn: 但是，长期的保护主义形式将无助于贫穷国家的发展，而对于发达国家来说，将产生敌对的贸易集团。
Translation: However, long-term forms of protectionism will not contribute to the development of poor countries, and for developed countries, they will lead to hostile trading blocs.

Query_Text_cn: 关于我一开始提到的全球化的争论已经主要集中在全球化对民族国家的含义上面。
Translation: The debate on globalization that I initially mentioned has primarily focused on its implications for nation-states.

Query_Text_cn: 民族国家的确仍然非常强大而且政治领导人在世界上也起着重要作用。
Translation: Nation-states remain very powerful, and political leaders continue to play a significant role in the world.

Query_Text_cn: 然而同时，我们可以看见，民族国家正在被重塑。
Translation: At the same time, however, we can see that nation-states are being reshaped.

Query_Text_cn: 民族经济政策不再像以前那样有效了。
Translation: National economic policies are no longer as effective as they once were.

Query_Text_cn: 更重要的是，这些国家不得不重新思考他们的认同，现在，旧有的地缘政治学正逐渐过时。
Translation: More importantly, these countries are compelled to rethink their identities, as the old geopolitics is gradually becoming obsolete.

Query_Text_cn: 我认为，尽管这个观点还存在争议，但是，随着冷战的消融，大部分国家不再有敌人了。
Translation: In my view, although this perspective remains controversial, most countries no longer have enemies as the Cold War has faded.

Query_Text_cn: 科索沃战争并不是国家与国家之间的斗争。
Translation: The Kosovo War was not a conflict between nation-states.

Query_Text_cn: 它是旧形式的地方民族主义与受伦理驱动的新干涉主义之间的冲突。
Translation: It is a conflict between traditional forms of local nationalism and a new interventionism driven by ethical considerations.

Query_Text_cn: 今天，国家面临的是风险和危险，而不是敌人,这二者在性质上发生了巨大的转变。
Translation: Today, the nation is confronted with risks and dangers rather than enemies, and there has been a fundamental shift in the nature of these challenges.

Query_Text_cn: 这样的观点不仅仅能够用来评论国家。
Translation: Such a perspective can be applied not only to the evaluation of nations.

Query_Text_cn: 在每一个地方，我们能够看见，许多制度从外表看与过去完全相同而且有着相同的名字，但是其实质内容却完全不同。
Translation: In every place, we can see that many institutions appear identical to those of the past and bear the same names, but their substantive content is entirely different.

Query_Text_cn: 我们继续谈论国家、家庭、工作、传统和自然，就好像它们与过去完全一样。
Translation: We continue to talk about the nation, family, work, tradition, and nature as if they are exactly the same as they were in the past.

Query_Text_cn: 然而，实际上并不是这样。
Translation: However, this is not the case in reality.

Query_Text_cn: 外表还在，但实质内容已经发生了变化，这不但发生在美国、英国或者法国，而且几乎每一个地方都是如此。
Translation: The appearance remains, but the substance has changed. This is not only happening in the United States, the United Kingdom, or France, but almost everywhere.

Query_Text_cn: 它们就是我所称的“外壳制度”。
Translation: They are what I refer to as "shell institutions."

Query_Text_cn: 它们是一些已经变得不能充分完成它们被要求执行的任务的制度。
Translation: They are institutions that have become unable to adequately fulfill the tasks they are required to perform.

Query_Text_cn: 正如我在这章中所描述的变化和变迁起着越来越大的作用一祥，它们正在产生一种以前从未存在过的东西，即一个全球的世界性社会。
Translation: As I have described in this chapter, changes and transformations are playing an increasingly significant role; they are giving rise to something that has never existed before—a global, worldwide society.

Query_Text_cn: 我们是生活在这个社会中的第一代人，现在我们只能模糊地看清它的轮廓。
Translation: We are the first generation living in this society, and for now, we can only vaguely discern its contours.

Query_Text_cn: 无论我们在什么地方，它正在动摇我们现存的生活方式。至少在目前，这个世界性社会不是由集体的人类意志所推动产生的全球秩序。
Translation: Wherever we are, it is shaking our existing way of life. At least for now, this global society is not a worldwide order driven by the collective will of humanity.

Query_Text_cn: 相反，它正以一种不固定的偶然的方式出现，同时带来一系列影响。
Translation: On the contrary, it is emerging in an unpredictable and incidental manner, bringing with it a range of consequences.

Query_Text_cn: 这个世界性社会不是固定安全的，而是充满了焦虑，并被深深的分化所影响。
Translation: This global society is not stable or secure; it is filled with anxiety and deeply affected by profound divisions.

Query_Text_cn: 我们中许多人都感受到许多我们无法控制的力量的控制。
Translation: Many of us feel controlled by forces beyond our control.

Query_Text_cn: 我认为，我们可以。
Translation: I believe we can.

Query_Text_cn: 我们所体验到的那种无能为力并不是个人失败的标志，而是反映出我们的制度无能为力。
Translation: The sense of powerlessness we experience is not a sign of personal failure, but rather a reflection of the impotence of our institutions.

Query_Text_cn: 我们需要重构我们曾经有过的这些制度，或者建立全新的制度。
Translation: We need to restructure the systems we once had or establish entirely new ones.

Query_Text_cn: 全球化并不是我们今天生活的附属物。它是我们生活环境的转变。
Translation: Globalization is not an accessory to our lives today; it is a transformation of the environment in which we live.

Query_Text_cn: 它是我们现在的生活方式。
Translation: It is our current way of life.

Query_Text_cn: 1998 年 7 月可能是世界历史上最热的一个月，1998 年全年也可能是最热的一年。
Translation: July 1998 may have been the hottest month in world history, and the entire year of 1998 may also have been the hottest year.

Query_Text_cn: 而作为一年，1998年可能是最热的一年。热浪浩劫肆虐了北半球的许多地方。
Translation: As a single year, 1998 may have been the hottest on record. Devastating heatwaves swept across many parts of the Northern Hemisphere.

Query_Text_cn: 例如，在以色列的埃拉特,温度几乎高达46摄氏度，同时,这个国家的水消费上升了40%。
Translation: For example, in Eilat, Israel, temperatures have reached nearly 46 degrees Celsius, while the country's water consumption has increased by 40%.

Query_Text_cn: 美国德克萨斯州的温度还远不止这么高。
Translation: Temperatures in Texas, USA, are even higher than this.

Query_Text_cn: 我们不敢肯定。但是，加上近年来飓风、台风和风暴不断增加，我们不得不承认这种可能性。
Translation: We cannot be certain. However, with the increasing frequency of hurricanes, typhoons, and storms in recent years, we have to acknowledge this possibility.

Query_Text_cn: 作为全球工业发展的结果，我们可能改变了世界的气候，还大大破坏了地球的生存环境。
Translation: As a result of global industrial development, we may have altered the world's climate and significantly damaged the Earth's living environment.

Query_Text_cn: 我们不知道进一步的改变将带来什么结果，我们也不知道它们将带来什么危险。
Translation: We do not know what outcomes further changes will bring, nor do we know what risks they may entail.

Query_Text_cn: 我们认为，它们都与风险联系在一起。我们可以通过风险这个概念来弄清这些问题。
Translation: We believe that they are all related to risk. We can clarify these issues through the concept of risk.

Query_Text_cn: 我希望说服你，使你相信,这个显然非常简单的概念却能说明我们生活其中的这个世界的一些最基本的特征。
Translation: I hope to persuade you and make you believe that this seemingly very simple concept can, in fact, explain some of the most fundamental characteristics of the world we live in.

Query_Text_cn: 与以前的时代相比较，乍一看，风险这个概念似乎可能与我们现在的时代没有任何具体的关系。
Translation: Compared to previous eras, at first glance, the concept of risk may seem to have no specific relevance to our current times.

Query_Text_cn: 欧洲中世纪的大多数人的生活都非常糟糕而且寿命很短，就像现在这个世界上较穷困地区的许多人的生活那样。
Translation: The lives of most people in medieval Europe were extremely harsh and short, much like those of many people in poorer regions of the world today.

Query_Text_cn: 但是，在这里，我们遇到了一些真正令人感兴趣的东西。
Translation: However, here we have come across something truly intriguing.

Query_Text_cn: 在中世纪,除了一些与风险相关的概念外，没有任何真正的风险概念。
Translation: In the Middle Ages, apart from some concepts related to risk, there was no genuine concept of risk.

Query_Text_cn: 就我能够发现的而言，在大多数其他传统文化中也没有风险这个概念。在16和17世纪，风险这个概念似乎已经有了，西方探险家们在开始他们的全世界航海时，他们第一次创造了这个概念。
Translation: As far as I can tell, the concept of risk does not exist in most other traditional cultures either. In the 16th and 17th centuries, the concept of risk seemed to have emerged, as Western explorers began their global voyages and created this concept for the first time.

Query_Text_cn: “风险”这个词好像是通过西班牙或葡萄牙人传人英语中的，他们使用风险这个词来指代航行到未知的水域。
Translation: The word "risk" appears to have been introduced into English by the Spanish or Portuguese, who used it to refer to sailing into unknown waters.

Query_Text_cn: 换句话说,风险这个词最早主要有空间方面的含义。
Translation: In other words, the term "risk" originally had primarily spatial connotations.

Query_Text_cn: 后来，它转向了时间方面，例如，它被使用在银行和投资方面主要是用来计算投资决策对借者和贷者可能带来的结果。
Translation: Later, it shifted towards time-related aspects; for example, it was used in banking and investment primarily to calculate the potential outcomes of investment decisions for borrowers and lenders.

Query_Text_cn: 因此，后来这个词就用来指代各种各样的不确定的情况。
Translation: Therefore, the term later came to refer to a wide range of uncertain situations.

Query_Text_cn: 我要指出，风险这个概念与可能性和不确定性概念是分不开的。
Translation: I want to point out that the concept of risk is inseparable from the concepts of probability and uncertainty.

Query_Text_cn: 当某种结果是百分之百的确定时，我们不能说这个人在冒风险。
Translation: When an outcome is one hundred percent certain, we cannot say that the person is taking a risk.

Query_Text_cn: 有一个古老的笑话非常清楚地表明了这一点。
Translation: An old joke illustrates this point very clearly.

Query_Text_cn: 有一个人从100层高的摩天大楼的顶上跳下来。
Translation: A person jumped from the top of a 100-story skyscraper.

Query_Text_cn: 在他往下跳经过每一层的时候，在大楼里的人听见他说：到目前为止，一切顺利”、“到目前为止，一切顺利”……他这样说似乎是他正在进行风险计箅，然而实际上，结果是已经确定了的。
Translation: As he jumped down past each floor, people inside the building heard him say, "So far, so good," "So far, so good"… It seemed as if he was conducting a risk assessment, but in reality, the outcome was already determined.

Query_Text_cn: 传统文化中并没有风险概念，因为他们并不需要这个概念。
Translation: There is no concept of risk in traditional culture, because they did not need such a concept.

Query_Text_cn: 风险与冒险或者危险是不同的。
Translation: Risk is different from adventure or danger.

Query_Text_cn: 风险指的是在与将来可能性关系中被评价的危险程度。
Translation: Risk refers to the degree of danger assessed in relation to future possibilities.

Query_Text_cn: 它只是在将来的社会中被广泛使用一这个社会正好把将来看作是被征服或者被殖民的范围。
Translation: It is only widely used in a future society—a society that happens to regard the future as a domain to be conquered or colonized.

Query_Text_cn: 风险暗示着一个企图主动与它的过去亦即现代工业文明的主要特征进行决裂的社会。
Translation: Risk implies a society that seeks to actively break away from its past, namely the main characteristics of modern industrial civilization.

Query_Text_cn: 所有以前的文化与文明包括世界上最伟大的早期文明如罗马或者传统中国都主要是存在于过去。
Translation: All previous cultures and civilizations, including the world's greatest early civilizations such as Rome or traditional China, have primarily existed in the past.

Query_Text_cn: 他们使用运气、命运或者上帝的意志等概念，现在，我们倾向于用风险来代替这些概念。
Translation: They used concepts such as luck, fate, or the will of God; now, we tend to replace these notions with the concept of risk.

Query_Text_cn: 在传统文化中，如果某人遭遇了一件意外事故或者相反取得了某种成功,那么,这就是运气、命运，或者这就是上帝及其灵魂的意志。
Translation: In traditional culture, if someone experiences an unexpected accident or, conversely, achieves some kind of success, it is considered to be luck, fate, or the will of God and His spirit.

Query_Text_cn: 有些文化否认碰巧出现的机会。一个叫做阿赞德人的非洲部落认为，当不幸降临某个人的时候,这就是巫术的结果。
Translation: Some cultures deny the existence of chance. An African tribe called the Azande believes that when misfortune befalls someone, it is the result of witchcraft.

Query_Text_cn: 例如，如果一个人生病了，那是因为敌人一直在施行巫术或者邪法。
Translation: For example, if someone falls ill, it is believed that the enemy has been continuously practicing witchcraft or sorcery.

Query_Text_cn: 当然，这些观念井没有随着现代化而完全消失。
Translation: Of course, these notions have not completely disappeared with modernization.

Query_Text_cn: 命运和宇宙论这些不可思议的观念和概念仍然有它的一席之地。
Translation: The incredible notions and concepts of fate and cosmology still have their place.

Query_Text_cn: 但是，它们通常秦作为迷信而继续存在，人们只是以某种尴尬的方式对它们半信半疑。
Translation: However, they usually persist as superstitions, with people remaining half-believing and half-doubting them in an awkward manner.

Query_Text_cn: 人们只是用它们来进一步支持那些具有更加精确计算性质的决定。
Translation: People merely use them to further support decisions that have a more precise computational nature.

Query_Text_cn: 赌徒们包括那些股票投机者们大多数都有那种心理上降低必定会遇见的不确定性的仪式。
Translation: Gamblers, including most stock speculators, tend to have rituals that psychologically reduce the uncertainty they are bound to encounter.

Query_Text_cn: 这同样适用于我们忍不住要去冒的风险，因为活着就是一件冒风险的事。
Translation: The same applies to the risks we cannot help but take, for to live is, in itself, to take risks.

Query_Text_cn: 人们仍然向占卜者咨询，在他们一生的重要时刻就更是如此，这并不令人吃惊。
Translation: It is not surprising that people still consult fortune-tellers, especially at important moments in their lives.

Query_Text_cn: 然而,接受风险也是激动和冒险的条件，你可以想像一些人从赌博、驾快车、性冒险主义或者投人到山车比赛场地等等冒险中所得到的快乐。
Translation: However, accepting risk is also a prerequisite for excitement and adventure. You can imagine the pleasure some people derive from gambling, speeding, sexual adventurism, or engaging in activities such as car racing.

Query_Text_cn: 而且，积极地接受风险也是现代经济中创造财富的精神源泉。
Translation: Moreover, actively embracing risk is also the driving force behind wealth creation in the modern economy.

Query_Text_cn: 风险的积极与消极的两个方面在现代工业社会的早期就经出现了。
Translation: The positive and negative aspects of risk emerged as early as the early stages of modern industrial society.

Query_Text_cn: 风险是一个致力于变化的社会的推动力，这样的一个社会想要决定自己的未来而不会任由它走向宗教、传统或者自然界的反复无常。
Translation: Risk is a driving force in a society committed to change—a society that seeks to determine its own future rather than leaving it to the vagaries of religion, tradition, or nature.

Query_Text_cn: 现代资本主义之所以与所有以前的经济体制不同就在于它对将来的态度。
Translation: What sets modern capitalism apart from all previous economic systems is its attitude toward the future.

Query_Text_cn: 以前的市场企业形式是不规范的或者局部的。
Translation: Previous forms of market enterprises were either unregulated or limited in scope.

Query_Text_cn: 例如，商人的活动从来没有削弱传统文明的基本结构，所有的传统文明依然主要是农业的或者农村的。
Translation: For example, the activities of merchants have never undermined the fundamental structure of traditional civilizations; all traditional civilizations have remained primarily agricultural or rural.

Query_Text_cn: 通过计算将来的利润与成本也就是计算风险，现代资本主义将自己融人到作为连续过程的将来之中。
Translation: By calculating future profits and costs—that is, by assessing risk—modern capitalism integrates itself into the future as a continuous process.

Query_Text_cn: 直到15世纪欧洲复式簿记制度的发明，资本主义才做到了这一点，复式簿记使得精确记录钱如何用于赚更多的钱成为可能。
Translation: It was not until the invention of the double-entry bookkeeping system in Europe in the 15th century that capitalism achieved this. Double-entry bookkeeping made it possible to accurately record how money was used to generate more money.

Query_Text_cn: 当然，我们的确希望尽可能地减少许多风险如影响健康的风险。
Translation: Of course, we do hope to minimize as many risks as possible, such as those that affect health.

Query_Text_cn: 这就是为什么从风险这个概念产生起就伴随了保险的出现的原因所在。
Translation: This is why the emergence of the concept of risk has been accompanied by the development of insurance.

Query_Text_cn: 我们不应诙将这里的保险仅仅看作是私人的或者商业保险。
Translation: We should not regard insurance here merely as private or commercial insurance.

Query_Text_cn: 福利国家的发展可以追溯到英国伊丽莎白一世时代的糟糕的法律，它实质上是一种风险管理系统。
Translation: The development of the welfare state can be traced back to the Poor Laws of the Elizabethan era in England, which essentially functioned as a risk management system.

Query_Text_cn: 这神体制的目的在于防止以前被认为是上帝安排的疾病、残疾、失业和终老这些灾难的。
Translation: The purpose of this divine system is to prevent disasters such as disease, disability, unemployment, and old age, which were previously regarded as acts of God.

Query_Text_cn: 保险是人们所能承受的准备冒的风险的底线。
Translation: Insurance is the minimum level of risk that people are willing to bear.

Query_Text_cn: 这就是安全的基础，这时，人们可以用对将来的积极运作来取代上天给予的命运。
Translation: This is the foundation of security; at this point, people can replace fate bestowed by heaven with proactive efforts toward the future.

Query_Text_cn: 与风险观念一样，现代保险形式开始于航海方面。
Translation: Like the concept of risk, modern forms of insurance originated in maritime activities.

Query_Text_cn: 据记载，最早的海洋保险在16世纪。
Translation: According to records, the earliest marine insurance dates back to the 16th century.

Query_Text_cn: 伦敦公司在1782年最早承担了海洋保险业务。
Translation: The London company first undertook marine insurance business in 1782.

Query_Text_cn: 在这之后不久，伦敦的在新兴的保险产业中占据了领头的位置，这个第一的位置持续了两个世纪。
Translation: Shortly thereafter, London took the lead in the emerging insurance industry, a position it maintained for two centuries.

Query_Text_cn: 保险只是在我们认为可以被人类控制的将来中才是可能的。
Translation: Insurance is only possible in a future that we believe can be controlled by humans.

Query_Text_cn: 保险正是进行这种控制的手段之一。
Translation: Insurance is one of the means of exercising such control.

Query_Text_cn: 保险就是提供安全保障,但是实际上它依赖于风险以及人们对风险的态度。
Translation: Insurance is about providing security, but in reality, it depends on risk and people's attitudes toward risk.

Query_Text_cn: 无论是私人保险还是国家福利体制的保险形式，提供保险的人实质上都只是在重新分配风险。
Translation: Whether it is private insurance or insurance under the national welfare system, those who provide insurance are essentially only redistributing risk.

Query_Text_cn: 如果某人投保了防止房屋被烧的火险，那么，风险就不会不存在。
Translation: If someone purchases fire insurance to protect their house from burning down, the risk does not cease to exist.

Query_Text_cn: 住户向保险公司支付报酬，同时将风险转移给保险公司。
Translation: Households pay premiums to insurance companies while transferring their risks to them.

Query_Text_cn: 风险的转移与交换并不仅仅是资本主义经济的偶然特征。实际上，如果没有它，资本主义是无法想像的也是难以运转的。
Translation: The transfer and exchange of risk are not merely incidental features of a capitalist economy. In fact, without them, capitalism would be unimaginable and difficult to operate.

Query_Text_cn: 因此，现代性总是涉及风险观念。但是，我想说，目前，风险具有一种新的特殊的重要性。
Translation: Therefore, modernity always involves the concept of risk. However, I would like to point out that, at present, risk holds a new and distinctive significance.

Query_Text_cn: 风险被认为是控制将来和规范将来的一种方式。
Translation: Risk is regarded as a means of controlling and regulating the future.

Query_Text_cn: 然而，事情并不是这样。
Translation: However, this is not the case.

Query_Text_cn: 我们控制将来的企图似乎对我们产生了意想不到的影响，它迫使我们寻找不同的方式来处理这种不确定性。
Translation: Our attempts to control the future seem to have unexpected effects on us, forcing us to seek different ways to cope with this uncertainty.

Query_Text_cn: 解释上述问题的最好方法就是区分两种类型的风险。
Translation: The best way to explain the above issue is to distinguish between two types of risks.

Query_Text_cn: 其中一种我称之为外部风险。
Translation: One type I refer to as external risk.

Query_Text_cn: 外部风险就是来自外部的、因为传统或者自然的不变性和固定性所带来的风险。
Translation: External risks refer to those arising from external sources, caused by the unchanging and fixed nature of tradition or natural factors.

Query_Text_cn: 我想把这种风险与被制造出来的风险区分开来。
Translation: I want to distinguish this type of risk from risks that are artificially created.

Query_Text_cn: 所谓被制造出来的风险，指的是由我们不断发展的知识对这个世界的影响所产生的风险，是指我们没有多少历史经验的情况下所产生的风险。
Translation: Manufactured risks refer to those arising from the impact of our continuously advancing knowledge on the world, and to risks that emerge in situations where we have little historical experience to draw upon.

Query_Text_cn: 大多数环境风险,例如那些与全球变暖有关的环境问题就属于这一类。
Translation: Most environmental risks, such as those related to global warming, fall into this category.

Query_Text_cn: 它们直接受到我们在第一章中所讨论的不断加强的全球化的影响。
Translation: They are directly affected by the intensifying globalization discussed in Chapter One.

Query_Text_cn: 澄清上述两种风险之间的区别的最好办法如下。
Translation: The best way to clarify the distinction between the two types of risks mentioned above is as follows.

Query_Text_cn: 我们可以认为，在所有传统文化中、在工业社会中以及直到今天，人类担心的都是来自外部的风险，如糟糕的收成、洪灾、盧疫或者饥荒等。
Translation: It can be said that throughout all traditional cultures, in industrial societies, and even up to the present day, humanity has primarily been concerned with external risks, such as poor harvests, floods, epidemics, or famines.

Query_Text_cn: 然而，在某个时刻（从历史的角度来说，也就是最近\我们开始很少担心自然能对我们怎么样，而更多地担心我们对自然所做的。
Translation: However, at a certain point (from a historical perspective, quite recently), we began to worry less about what nature could do to us and more about what we were doing to nature.

Query_Text_cn: 这标志着外部风险所占的主导地位转变成了被制造出来的风险占主要地位。
Translation: This marks a shift from the dominance of external risks to the predominance of manufactured risks.

Query_Text_cn: 我认为，它指的是我们所有的人，不管我们是处在这个世界的较富或者较贫穷的地区。
Translation: I believe it refers to all of us, regardless of whether we are in the wealthier or poorer regions of the world.

Query_Text_cn: 同时，富裕地区与其他地区的差异是非常明显的。
Translation: At the same time, the differences between affluent regions and other areas are very pronounced.

Query_Text_cn: 许多更加“传统的”风险(也就是上面提到的那种风险，如因为糟糕的收成而造成的饥荒)在较贫穷的国家仍然存在，同时还交织着新风险。
Translation: Many more "traditional" risks—such as those mentioned above, like famine caused by poor harvests—still persist in poorer countries, while new risks are also emerging and intertwining with them.

Query_Text_cn: 我们的社会存在于自然结束之后。
Translation: Our society exists after the end of nature.

Query_Text_cn: 很明显，自然的结束并不是指物质世界或物理过程不再存在。
Translation: It is clear that the end of nature does not refer to the disappearance of the material world or physical processes.

Query_Text_cn: 它是指我们周围的物质环境没有什么方面不受人类干扰的某种方式的影响。
Translation: It refers to the fact that there is virtually no aspect of our surrounding material environment that is not affected in some way by human interference.

Query_Text_cn: 过去曾经是自然的许多东西现在都不再完全是自然的了，尽管我们并不总是能够确定某种过程何时开始何时结束。
Translation: Many things that were once considered natural are no longer entirely so, even though we are not always able to determine exactly when a certain process begins or ends.

Query_Text_cn: 在1998年,中国发生了洪灾，许多人失去了他们的家园。
Translation: In 1998, China experienced a flood, and many people lost their homes.

Query_Text_cn: 中国大多数河流的泛滥在历史上都是周期性发生的。
Translation: Flooding of most rivers in China has historically occurred on a cyclical basis.

Query_Text_cn: 没有人知道答案。但是，这些洪灾的某些不同寻常的特征表明了它们的起因并不是完全自然的。
Translation: No one knows the answer. However, some unusual characteristics of these floods suggest that their causes are not entirely natural.

Query_Text_cn: 被制造出来的风险并不只涉及自然一过去所涉及的多数是自然的。
Translation: Manufactured risks are not limited to those involving nature—most of the risks in the past were primarily natural.

Query_Text_cn: 它还渗透到生活的其他领域。
Translation: It has also permeated other areas of life.

Query_Text_cn: 就拿婚姻和家庭来说吧，在工业国家，它们现在正在经历深刻的变化，从一定程度上来说，全世界也是如此。
Translation: Take marriage and family as an example. In industrialized countries, they are currently undergoing profound changes, and to some extent, this is true worldwide as well.

Query_Text_cn: 两三代前，人们结婚的时候，他们知道他们正在做什么。
Translation: Two or three generations ago, when people got married, they knew what they were doing.

Query_Text_cn: 主要由传统和习俗决定的婚姻与自然状态是紧密联系在一起的，这种情况在许多国家当然是事实。
Translation: Marriage, which is primarily determined by tradition and custom, is closely linked to the state of nature; this is certainly the case in many countries.

Query_Text_cn: 然而，凡是在传统的处事方法正在消失的地方，由于婚姻和家庭制度已经发生了如此大的变化，人们不知道自己在做什么就有了重要的意义。
Translation: However, wherever traditional ways of doing things are disappearing and the institutions of marriage and family have undergone such significant changes, it becomes highly significant that people no longer know what they are doing.

Query_Text_cn: 在这里，作为先锋的个人再度受到冲击。
Translation: Here, the individual as a pioneer is once again impacted.

Query_Text_cn: 在这种情况下，这是不可避免的，即无论他们知道与否，他们都开始从风险的角度思考得越来越多。
Translation: In this situation, it is inevitable that, whether they are aware of it or not, they increasingly begin to think from the perspective of risk.

Query_Text_cn: 他们不得不面临个人的将来，与过去相比，他们的将来越来越不可决定，其中充满了各种机会与风险。
Translation: They have to confront their personal future, which, compared to the past, is increasingly unpredictable and filled with various opportunities and risks.

Query_Text_cn: 正当被制造出来的风险扩张的时候，风险也变得危险重重。
Translation: As artificially created risks expand, they also become increasingly perilous.

Query_Text_cn: 正如我在前面所指出的那样，风险观念的出现是与计算的可能性紧密联系在一起的。
Translation: As I pointed out earlier, the emergence of the concept of risk is closely linked to the possibility of calculation.

Query_Text_cn: 大多数保险形式是直接建立在这种联系的基础之上的。
Translation: Most forms of insurance are directly built upon this connection.

Query_Text_cn: 例如，每当某个人走入汽车的时候,人们就能够计箅出这个人发生事故的可能性。
Translation: For example, whenever someone gets into a car, people can calculate the likelihood of that person being involved in an accident.

Query_Text_cn: 这是保险精算的预测一这是长期以来产生的可能性。
Translation: This is an actuarial projection in insurance, representing a probability that has emerged over a long period.

Query_Text_cn: 被制造出来的风险就不是这种情形。
Translation: Manufactured risks do not fall into this category.

Query_Text_cn: 我们完全不知道风险的大小和程度，而且在很多情况下，直到很晚，我们也不能确切知道这种风险的大小。
Translation: We have no idea about the magnitude and extent of the risk, and in many cases, we cannot know its exact size until very late.

Query_Text_cn: 不久前0996年）正是乌克兰切尔诺贝利核电站事故的十周年纪念。
Translation: Not long ago, 1996 marked the tenth anniversary of the Chernobyl nuclear power plant accident in Ukraine.

Query_Text_cn: 没有人知道这个事故的长期后果会是什么。
Translation: No one knows what the long-term consequences of this incident will be.

Query_Text_cn: 在将来的某个时候,可能会发生也可能不会发生威胁健康的潜在的灾难。
Translation: At some point in the future, a potential disaster that could threaten health may or may not occur.

Query_Text_cn: 英国发生过牛海绵状脑病，也就是所谓的疯牛病。从这种病对人类的影响角度来说，我们同样不知道将来会发生什么。
Translation: The United Kingdom has experienced bovine spongiform encephalopathy, commonly known as mad cow disease. From the perspective of its impact on humans, we likewise do not know what may happen in the future.

Query_Text_cn: 目前，我们不能肯定将来的某个时间是否会有更多的人患上这种病。
Translation: At present, we cannot be certain whether more people will develop this disease at some point in the future.

Query_Text_cn: 我们还可以拿世界气候变迁为例。
Translation: We can also take global climate change as an example.

Query_Text_cn: 对这个领域非常精通的大多数科学家都认为，全球正在逐渐变暖，对此必须采取措施。
Translation: Most scientists who are highly knowledgeable in this field believe that the world is gradually warming and that action must be taken in response.

Query_Text_cn: 然而，就是在20世纪70年代中期，正统科学家们仍然认为，这个世界正处于全球变冷的阶段。
Translation: However, even in the mid-1970s, mainstream scientists still believed that the world was undergoing a period of global cooling.

Query_Text_cn: 原来用来证明全球变冷命题的相同证据现在又被用于支持全球变暖问题，如，热浪、寒冷时期这些不寻常的天气。
Translation: The same evidence that was once used to support the theory of global cooling is now being used to support the issue of global warming, such as unusual weather events like heatwaves and cold spells.

Query_Text_cn: 全球正在变暧吗？它的出现有人类的因素吗？也许吧，但是我们不能完全确定，我们只能等待。
Translation: Is the world really getting warmer? Are there human factors involved in its occurrence? Maybe, but we can't be completely sure. All we can do is wait.

Query_Text_cn: 在这些环境中，有一种新的政治学的道德气候，在对散布谣言者（扰乱社会民心者）的谴责与掩饰之间的推力与拉力是这种道德气候的标志。
Translation: In these environments, a new moral climate of political science has emerged, characterized by the tension between the condemnation of rumor-mongers (those who disrupt public sentiment) and the efforts to conceal or downplay their actions.

Query_Text_cn: 如果任何人一政府官员、科学专家或研究人员一都正视这种风险，那么，他们一定会将这种风险揭示出来。
Translation: If anyone—a government official, scientific expert, or researcher—acknowledges this risk, they will certainly disclose it.

Query_Text_cn: 它一定会被广泛宣传，因为人们一定会认为，这种风险是真的人们肯定会对此小题大做。
Translation: It will certainly be widely publicized, because people will undoubtedly believe that this risk is real and are bound to make a big deal out of it.

Query_Text_cn: 然而，如果真的小题大做，而寧种风险又被证明非常小，那么，那些参与其中的人就会被别人谴责成妖言惑众。
Translation: However, if the issue is indeed exaggerated and the risk of Ning species turns out to be minimal, those involved will be accused by others of spreading alarmist rumors.

Query_Text_cn: 然而，假定权威们最初认定这种风险不是非常大，就像英国政府在对待被污染的牛肉事件时那样，政府首先就会说:我们得到了科学家的支持;根本不存在那么严重的风险，想吃牛肉的人可以毫不担心地继续吃牛肉。
Translation: However, if the authorities initially determine that the risk is not very significant, as the British government did in response to the contaminated beef incident, the government will first state: We have the support of scientists; the risk is not as serious as claimed, and those who wish to eat beef can continue to do so without concern.

Query_Text_cn: 在这种情况下，如果事情被证明是另外一种情形，那么，权威们就会被谴责掩饰了实情。
Translation: In this case, if it turns out to be a different situation, the authorities will be condemned for concealing the truth.

Query_Text_cn: 事情甚至比这些例子所表明的还更为复杂。
Translation: The situation is even more complex than these examples suggest.

Query_Text_cn: 荒谬的是，散布谣言对于减少我们面临的风险可能是必须的。然而，如果这种谣言真的减少了风险，那么，它就真的成了谣言。
Translation: Ironically, spreading rumors may be necessary to reduce the risks we face. However, if such rumors truly reduce those risks, then they cease to be mere rumors.

Query_Text_cn: 艾滋病就是这样一个例子。
Translation: AIDS is a case in point.

Query_Text_cn: 政府和专家们使得公众非常重视与不安全的性有关的风险，这使得人们改变了他们的性行为。
Translation: The government and experts have made the public highly aware of the risks associated with unsafe sex, prompting people to change their sexual behavior.

Query_Text_cn: 这样，在一定程度上，发达国家的艾滋病并没有像原来预测的那样蔓延。
Translation: In this way, to a certain extent, the spread of AIDS in developed countries has not occurred as originally predicted.

Query_Text_cn: 然而，正如我们从艾滋病不断扩展的全球蔓延中知道，他们这样做完全是对的。
Translation: However, as we have learned from the ongoing global spread of AIDS, they are absolutely right to do so.

Query_Text_cn: 这种荒谬的事在当代社会中变成了常有的事，但是，我们却没有什么可供选择的方法来解决它。
Translation: Such absurdities have become commonplace in contemporary society, yet we have few available options to address them.

Query_Text_cn: 正如我在前面提到的，在大部分被制造出来的风险中，是否存在风险甚至都可能会受到怀疑。
Translation: As I mentioned earlier, for most manufactured risks, the very existence of risk itself may even be subject to doubt.

Query_Text_cn: 我们不能预先知道我们什么时候真的在散布谣言，什么时候又没散布谣言。
Translation: We cannot know in advance when we are truly spreading rumors and when we are not.

Query_Text_cn: 今天，我们与科学和技术的关系不同于早期时代。
Translation: Today, our relationship with science and technology is different from that of earlier times.

Query_Text_cn: 大约在两个世纪中，西方社会的科学起着一神传统的功能。
Translation: For approximately two centuries, science in Western societies has served the function traditionally fulfilled by monotheism.

Query_Text_cn: 科学知识被认为战胜了传统，但实际上科学知识本身也在某种程度上变成了传统。
Translation: Scientific knowledge is believed to have triumphed over tradition, but in reality, scientific knowledge itself has, to some extent, become a form of tradition.

Query_Text_cn: 科学知识是大多数人所尊重的东西，但是，对于人们的活动来说，它们是外在的、客观的。
Translation: Scientific knowledge is respected by most people; however, it remains external and objective in relation to human activities.

Query_Text_cn: 普通人“吸取了”专家们的观点。
Translation: Ordinary people have "absorbed" the views of experts.

Query_Text_cn: 科学和技术渗透到我们的生活中越多，持这种观点的人就越少。
Translation: The more science and technology permeate our lives, the fewer people hold this view.

Query_Text_cn: 与过去的情况相比，我们中的大部分人，包括政府权威和政治家，现在都与科学技术有着更多的积极关系。
Translation: Compared to the past, most of us, including government authorities and politicians, now have a more positive relationship with science and technology.

Query_Text_cn: 我们不能完全“接受”科学家所提供的发现，主要是因为科学家们通常的看法都不统一，尤其在风险是被制造出来的情况下。
Translation: We cannot fully "accept" the findings provided by scientists, primarily because their views are often inconsistent, especially when risks are artificially created.

Query_Text_cn: 而且，现在每一个人都认识到科学的动态特征。
Translation: Moreover, it is now recognized by everyone that science is dynamic in nature.

Query_Text_cn: 当某人决定吃什么、早餐吃什么、是喝无咖啡因的咖啡还是普通咖啡时，这个人就得在相互冲突的、可改变的科学技术信息环境下作出决定。
Translation: When someone decides what to eat, what to have for breakfast, or whether to drink decaffeinated coffee or regular coffee, they must make these choices in a scientific and technological information environment that is conflicting and subject to change.

Query_Text_cn: 以红葡萄酒作为例子。
Translation: Take red wine as an example.

Query_Text_cn: 以前人们认为红葡萄酒和其他的酒精饮料掺在一起喝有害于身体健康。
Translation: It was previously believed that mixing red wine with other alcoholic beverages was harmful to one's health.

Query_Text_cn: 然而，研究表明，喝适量的红葡萄酒可以防止心脏病。
Translation: However, studies have shown that drinking a moderate amount of red wine can help prevent heart disease.

Query_Text_cn: 后来还发现，任何形式的酒都将有这种作用，但是，这种保护作用只出现在40岁以上的人中。
Translation: It was later found that any form of alcohol can have this effect; however, this protective effect is only observed in individuals over the age of 40.

Query_Text_cn: 有人认为，防止出现被制造出来的风险的最有效的方法就是通过采取所谓的“预防原则”来限制责任。
Translation: Some believe that the most effective way to prevent artificially created risks is to limit liability by adopting the so-called "precautionary principle."

Query_Text_cn: 预防原则这个概念最早于20世纪80年代出现在德国，当时，德国正在开展生态学争论。
Translation: The concept of the precautionary principle first emerged in Germany in the 1980s, during a period of ecological debate in the country.

Query_Text_cn: 简单地说，预防原则是指，即使存在不安全的科学证据，人们也必须对环境问题(也可以推及其他形式的风险）采取措施。
Translation: Simply put, the precautionary principle means that even in the absence of conclusive scientific evidence of safety, measures must be taken to address environmental issues (and, by extension, other forms of risk).

Query_Text_cn: 因此，在20世纪80年代，尽管英国缺乏用于论证不对酸雨和其他污染问题采取行动的决定性证据，几个欧洲国家还是开展了一系列活动防止酸雨。
Translation: Therefore, in the 1980s, despite the lack of conclusive evidence in the UK to justify action on acid rain and other pollution issues, several European countries still launched a series of initiatives to prevent acid rain.

Query_Text_cn: 然而，作为解决风险和责任问题的方式，预防原则并不总是有用的甚或是可应用的。
Translation: However, as a means of addressing risks and responsibilities, the precautionary principle is not always useful or even applicable.

Query_Text_cn: “接近自然”或者限制创新而不是促进创新这个原则并不总是可行的。
Translation: The principle of "approaching nature" or restricting innovation rather than promoting it is not always feasible.

Query_Text_cn: 原因就在于科技进步或者其他形式的社会变化的作用和反作用之间的平衡是非常重要的。
Translation: The reason lies in the fact that maintaining a balance between the effects and counter-effects of technological advancement or other forms of social change is extremely important.

Query_Text_cn: 对于基因改良食品的争论就是一个例子，基因改良作物已经在世界上种植了3500万公顷，大约相当于英国面积的1.5倍。
Translation: The debate over genetically modified foods is one example; genetically modified crops are already being cultivated on 35 million hectares worldwide, which is approximately 1.5 times the size of the United Kingdom.

Query_Text_cn: 其中大部分种植于北美和中国。
Translation: The majority of them are cultivated in North America and China.

Query_Text_cn: 基因改良作物包括大豆、玉米、棉花和土豆。
Translation: Genetically modified crops include soybeans, corn, cotton, and potatoes.

Query_Text_cn: 并没有非常明显的证据说明现在的自然界不是自然的了。
Translation: There is no clear evidence indicating that the natural world today is no longer natural.

Query_Text_cn: 真正的危险在于很多已知的和未知的东西，如果我可以这么说的话，因为这个世界经显现出一种让我们惊奇的趋势。
Translation: The real danger lies in the many known and unknown factors, if I may put it this way, because the world often exhibits trends that astonish us.

Query_Text_cn: 也许会有以前根本没有人预测得到的结果出现。比如人们食用的这些农作物会不会带来中长期的危害。
Translation: There may be outcomes that no one could have predicted in the past. For example, whether the consumption of these crops will pose medium- or long-term risks.

Query_Text_cn: 总之，现在应用的大量的基因技术是非常新的，与以前的杂交等技术甚至有本质上的不同。
Translation: In summary, many of the genetic technologies currently in use are very new and fundamentally different from previous techniques such as hybridization.

Query_Text_cn: 反过来会对环境的生物多样性造成威胁。
Translation: Conversely, it poses a threat to the biodiversity of the environment.

Query_Text_cn: 即便这种禁止是行得通的，那也不是非常简单的事情。
Translation: Even if such a ban were feasible, it would not be a straightforward matter.

Query_Text_cn: 理想的民主要求公共政策得到“一人一票”原则的指导，但在所有现实政治体制中，特殊利益集团都会积极参与政策决策过程。本书探讨特殊利益集团在民主政治中所起的作用。
Translation: Ideal democracy requires that public policy be guided by the principle of "one person, one vote," but in all real-world political systems, special interest groups actively participate in the policy-making process. This book explores the role that special interest groups play in democratic politics.

Query_Text_cn: 社会科学家们对于特殊利益集团的定义还没有形成完全共识部分学者使用“特殊利益集团”的名称广义地表示具有相似的社会或人口的特征、相似信念、相似利益、相似政策偏好的部分选民集合。其他学者利用“特殊利益集团”这一词语表示代表组织成员参与政治活动的成员关系组织。此处，我们并不将自己限定于任何特殊利益集团的定义。第三章提出特殊利益集团的宽泛定义，并讨论特定社会团体依靠自身投票行为获取政府优待的能力。在第三章，我们认为特殊利益集团是具有部分相似政策内容偏好的可识别选民团体随后，我们集中讨论代表某个集团的选民釆取政治行动的组织。第四章描述有组织团体从事的活动，并且将特殊利益集团定义为参与有组织活动的任何团体。我们认为，特殊利益集团的“成员”是利益集团领导者在决定自己行动时需要考虑相应个人福利的那些个体成员。利益集团的成员可能需要定期付费，也可能不需要定期付费。
Translation: Social scientists have not yet reached a complete consensus on the definition of special interest groups. Some scholars use the term "special interest group" broadly to refer to subsets of voters who share similar social or demographic characteristics, beliefs, interests, or policy preferences. Other scholars use the term to denote membership organizations that represent their members in political activities. Here, we do not confine ourselves to any particular definition of special interest groups. Chapter Three presents a broad definition of special interest groups and discusses the ability of specific social groups to secure government favors through their voting behavior. In Chapter Three, we consider special interest groups to be identifiable groups of voters with partially similar policy preferences. Subsequently, we focus on organizations that represent these groups and engage in political action. Chapter Four describes the activities undertaken by organized groups and defines special interest groups as any group participating in organized activities. We believe that the "members" of a special interest group are those individuals whose welfare must be considered by group leaders when making decisions. Members of interest groups may or may not be required to pay regular dues.

Query_Text_cn: 在美国有多少特殊利益集团？考虑到定义特殊利益集团的难度，几乎难以回答美国存在多少特殊利益集团的问题也就不令人惊奇了。部分学者依靠粗略iE?利益团体名称及其分女机枸情况的((协会大全》来估计美国的特殊利益集团的数量2000年版的《协会大全》罗列了22000多个在全国范围内活动的美国非菅利成员组织。然而并非所有非营利成员组织都成为特殊利益集闭，只有将近1/3左右的非营利成员雜织利用0己掌握的资源参与政治活动。1959年版的《协会大全H己录的非营利成员组织的数量是5S43个，而19S0年版的《协会大全》记录了14726个非营利成员组织的名称。尽管不能知道非营利成员组织的数量在多大程度上反映了团体机构的实际分支情况、《协会大全》出版者的研究努力程度，以及《协会大全》分类标准的变化情况，但非营利成员组织的数量反映了有组织利益团体的迅速增加。
Translation: How many special interest groups are there in the United States? Given the difficulty of defining what constitutes a special interest group, it is hardly surprising that the question of how many special interest groups exist in the United States is almost impossible to answer. Some scholars rely on rough estimates based on the names of interest groups and their subcategories listed in the Encyclopedia of Associations. The 2000 edition of the Encyclopedia of Associations listed more than 22,000 nonprofit membership organizations active nationwide in the United States. However, not all nonprofit membership organizations qualify as special interest groups; only about one-third of these organizations use their resources to participate in political activities. The 1959 edition of the Encyclopedia of Associations recorded 5,543 nonprofit membership organizations, while the 1980 edition listed 14,726 such organizations. Although it is unclear to what extent the number of nonprofit membership organizations reflects the actual number of group branches, the research efforts of the encyclopedia’s publishers, or changes in its classification standards, the increase in the number of nonprofit membership organizations does indicate a rapid growth in organized interest groups.

Query_Text_cn: 另一本出版物《华盛顿代理》，列出了11000多个1999年在华盛顿特区从事代理丁__UNDEF__作的公司、协会和公共利益团体的名称。11000多个代理机构的数量大大超过早年的数量，1979年版的《华盛顿代理》只包括4000个代理机枸的名称。作为在美国政府登记沣册的满足《1974年联邦选举活动法案》要求的组织，政治行动委员会在1999年可以合法地向3S35名政治候选人提供捐款，这一数字反映了政治行动委员会捐助的政治候选人数量的急速增长.虽然政治行动委员会在1984年捐助的政治候选人就已接近4000人，但在1984-1999年间，政治行动委员会捐助的政治候选人的数量相对稳定，而1974年与1979年政治行动委员会注册登记赞助的政治候选人分别为608人与2000人。上述统计数字给予我们的总体印象是参与美闰全国性政治的特殊利益集团的数量不小，并且还在继续增加。
Translation: Another publication, *Washington Representatives*, lists the names of more than 11,000 companies, associations, and public interest groups engaged in lobbying activities in Washington, D.C. in 1999. This number of over 11,000 lobbying organizations is a significant increase compared to earlier years; the 1979 edition of *Washington Representatives* included only the names of 4,000 lobbying organizations. As organizations registered with the U.S. government in compliance with the requirements of the Federal Election Campaign Act of 1974, political action committees (PACs) in 1999 were legally allowed to make contributions to 3,535 political candidates. This figure reflects the rapid growth in the number of political candidates receiving contributions from PACs. Although the number of candidates supported by PACs had already approached 4,000 in 1984, the number remained relatively stable between 1984 and 1999. In contrast, in 1974 and 1979, the number of political candidates registered and sponsored by PACs was 608 and 2,000, respectively. The overall impression given by these statistics is that the number of special interest groups participating in national politics in the United States is considerable and continues to grow.

Query_Text_cn: 特殊利益集团代表非常不同的个人与利益集合。一些（但不是全部）团体的组织基础是经济利益。大多数优秀的集团代表着商业利益，例如，贸易协会(半导体工业协会和美国生铁与钢铁协会）、高层商业协会（美国商会和全国制造业协会），以及位于华盛顿政治要地的一些个人公司，多数团体也代表职业利益，包括工会（美国邮政工人联盟和美国教师协会）、专业协会(美国医师协会和全闰律师协会），以及农业团体（全国农场主协会）非物质利益也能找到自己的政治代表，希望代表具有相同意识形态或社会问题的观点的个人，或希望政府的政策能反映自己观点的个人组成团体例如，存在代表不同宗教观点（美国犹太协会和基督教联盟K药物与酒的政策（反对酒后驾驶的母亲协会和改革大麻法案的全国组织）、枪支管制（全国枪支协会和手枪控制公司）、流产权利（全闰生命权利组织和全闰流产与繁殖权利行动联盟）、公民权利（促进有色人种的全国协会）、同性恋权利（全国男女同性恋特遣队）、死刑(法律秩序市民协会与全国废除死刑协会）和许多其他问题的团体。部分团体同时表达经济与非经济的政策目标，例如，“塞拉俱乐部”的环境团体，以及“美国退伍军人协会”的老兵团体均属此列。
Translation: Special interest groups represent very different individuals and sets of interests. Some, but not all, groups are organized around economic interests. Most prominent groups represent business interests, such as trade associations (the Semiconductor Industry Association and the American Iron and Steel Institute), major business associations (the U.S. Chamber of Commerce and the National Association of Manufacturers), as well as certain individual companies located in Washington’s political hub. Many groups also represent professional interests, including labor unions (the American Postal Workers Union and the American Federation of Teachers), professional associations (the American Medical Association and the American Bar Association), and agricultural groups (the National Farmers Union). Non-material interests also find political representation, with groups formed by individuals who share similar ideological or social issue perspectives, or who wish government policy to reflect their views. For example, there are groups representing different religious perspectives (the American Jewish Committee and the Christian Coalition), policies on drugs and alcohol (Mothers Against Drunk Driving and the National Organization for the Reform of Marijuana Laws), gun control (the National Rifle Association and Handgun Control Inc.), abortion rights (the National Right to Life Committee and the National Abortion and Reproductive Rights Action League), civil rights (the National Association for the Advancement of Colored People), gay rights (the National Gay and Lesbian Task Force), the death penalty (the Citizens for Law and Order and the National Coalition to Abolish the Death Penalty), and many other issues. Some groups pursue both economic and non-economic policy goals, such as environmental groups like the Sierra Club and veterans’ groups like the American Legion.

Query_Text_cn: 鲍姆加特纳和利奇将1995年版《协会大全》罗列的团体分成18类，并且给出了各类团体的活动范围与分布。根据鲍姆加特纳和利奇的研究，数量居于前列的团体分是贸易和商业协会(3973个大于、健康与医疗协会(2426个）、公共事务协会(2178个）、文化组织(1938个）和社会福利组织（1938个）。此外，还有1243个宗教团体、1136个环境与农业团体和226个工会组织。施洛茨曼和蒂尔尼采用略微不同的利益集团分类方法分析了1981年版《华盛顿代理》记载的代表机枸名单。然而，除了釆用不同组织利益的分类方法外，分析结论都是一致的，即特殊利益集团几乎活跃千政府政策决策的全部领域。
Translation: Baumgartner and Leech divided the groups listed in the 1995 edition of the Encyclopedia of Associations into 18 categories and provided the scope and distribution of activities for each type of group. According to their research, the groups with the largest numbers are trade and business associations (3,973), health and medical associations (2,426), public affairs associations (2,178), cultural organizations (1,938), and social welfare organizations (1,938). In addition, there are 1,243 religious groups, 1,136 environmental and agricultural groups, and 226 labor unions. Schlozman and Tierney analyzed the list of representative organizations recorded in the 1981 edition of the Washington Representatives using a slightly different classification method for interest groups. However, aside from the different approaches to categorizing organizational interests, the analytical conclusions are consistent: special interest groups are active in nearly all areas of government policy decision-making.

Query_Text_cn: 从麦迪逊撰写著名的（联邦制拥护论:涉及的团体问题开始，处理特殊利益集团在民主政治中所起作用的问题就成为规范研究的内容6社会科学家们对于一些问题存在不同意见，例如：特殊利益对政治与社会产生积极影响还是消极影响；特殊利益集团的集体性活动是否获得近似社会最优的结果；团体利益是否取代公共利益，等等D相反地，本书的多数分析涉及实证问题，我们对利益集团发挥影响力的条件和确定利益集团影响力程度的因素感兴趣.我们也希望知道特殊利益集团采用的各种不同影响方法及其各种方法的有效性差异的原因.最后，我们对特殊利益之间的竞争结果感兴趣，希望知道当一些团体追求相互对立的政策目标时，哪些团体占据优势。进一步地，随着研究的深化，我们写作本书的意图也包含对方法设的研究。我们希望推进使用我们认为适合政治竞争分析而较少应用于特殊利益政治的特定方法。
Translation: Since Madison wrote the famous Federalist Papers and began addressing the issue of factions, the role of special interest groups in democratic politics has become a subject of normative study. Social scientists have differing opinions on several issues, such as whether special interests have a positive or negative impact on politics and society; whether the collective activities of special interest groups yield results close to social optimum; and whether group interests replace the public interest, among others. In contrast, most of the analyses in this book focus on empirical questions. We are interested in the conditions under which interest groups exert influence and the factors that determine the extent of their influence. We also seek to understand the various methods special interest groups use to exert influence and the reasons for differences in the effectiveness of these methods. Finally, we are interested in the outcomes of competition among special interests and wish to know which groups hold advantages when some pursue opposing policy goals. Furthermore, as our research deepens, our intention in writing this book also includes methodological inquiry. We hope to promote the use of certain methods that we believe are well-suited for the analysis of political competition but have been less frequently applied to the politics of special interests.

Query_Text_cn: 利益集团参与推进其政治目标的各种活动.大量的综述性研究具体记录了组织及其代理者的活动，早期的研究有米尔布拉斯小于Milbrath，1963),近期的研究包括贝里（Berry,1977)、施洛茨曼和蒂尔尼（SchlozmanandTler-ney，1986)、沃克（Walker，1991)、海因茨等（HeinzetaU1993)，以及诺尼思和弗里曼(NownesandFreeman，1998)等JU本节描述利益集团的活动，并讨论利益集团的各种可能流行的活动方法及其资源使用的趋势。本节的一般性介绍为以后各章具体分析各种不同形式的利益集团的活动奠定基础。
Translation: Interest groups engage in a variety of activities to advance their political objectives. Numerous comprehensive studies have documented the activities of organizations and their agents, including early research by Milbrath (1963) and more recent studies by Berry (1977), Schlozman and Tierney (1986), Walker (1991), Heinz et al. (1993), and Nownes and Freeman (1998). This section describes the activities of interest groups and discusses the various popular methods they employ, as well as trends in their use of resources. The general overview provided in this section lays the foundation for the detailed analysis of the activities of different types of interest groups in subsequent chapters.

Query_Text_cn: 根据各种调发现,试图教育劝说立法者接受利益集团的政策主张的组织化的利益集团的数量最多。利益集团的活动主要体现在众所周知的游说活动，施洛茨曼和蒂尔尼（SchlozmanandTierney，1986)通过访问调175个华盛顿代理机构得出：99%的团体准备参加议会听证或代理人听证的活动；98%的团体在立法者的办公场所与立法者见面；95%的团体利用会议、午餐或其他类似形式与立法者保持非正式联系；92%的团体向政策制定者提供自己的研究成果和技术信息此外，36%的团体表示与政府官员保持直接联系是利益集团耗费自身最多时间或资源的（27个选项清单之中的）5大任务之一,27%的团体认为参加听证活动与传递研究成果和技术信息成为三大最耗费时间资源的活动的组成部分。没有其他活动的重要性髙于上述种常见活动海因茨等（Heimetal.，]993)对将近800个华盛顿代理机构实施的访问调也论证了游说活动的普遍性。诺尼思和弗里曼(NownesandFreeman，]998)对三个州的州府的595个代理机构与301个利益团体实施的邮件调查也发现了游说活动的普遍存在性。
Translation: According to various surveys, the largest number of organized interest groups are those that attempt to educate and persuade legislators to accept the policy positions of interest groups. The activities of interest groups are mainly reflected in the well-known lobbying activities. Schlozman and Tierney (1986), through interviews with 175 Washington agencies, found that: 99% of groups were prepared to participate in congressional or agency hearings; 98% of groups met with legislators in their offices; 95% of groups maintained informal contact with legislators through meetings, lunches, or other similar forms; and 92% of groups provided policymakers with their own research findings and technical information. In addition, 36% of groups indicated that maintaining direct contact with government officials was one of the five most time- or resource-consuming tasks (among a list of 27 options), and 27% of groups considered participating in hearings and delivering research findings and technical information as part of the three most time- and resource-consuming activities. No other activities were considered more important than these common ones. Heinz et al. (1993), through interviews with nearly 800 Washington agencies, also demonstrated the prevalence of lobbying activities. Nownes and Freeman (1998), through a mail survey of 595 agencies and 301 interest groups in the capitals of three states, also found the widespread existence of lobbying activities.

Query_Text_cn: 类似伯恩鲍姆和默里（BirnbaumandMurray,1987)、史密斯（Smith,1988)和伯恩鲍姆(Birnbaum，1992)对游说活动的新闻记录报道勾画出特殊利益的代理者几乎涉足全部立法过程的生动画面。游说者的活动具体包括会见政策同情者、帮助策划立法战略、协助立法者构思法律草案、拜见持观望态度的立法者并尽量获取他们的支持、破坏立法者之间的相互立法交易等，为何游说者的力量普遍存在于华盛顿或各州的州府？新闻记者和确证性访问调查的研究表明，游说者具有明显的信息获取优势。既然立法者需要处理大量复杂的高难度技术性问题，就不能指望只利用自身资源与专门技术就可以获得全部相关知识。因为利益集团不仅已经通过日常所接触到的政策决策而熟悉了许多技术细节问题，而且准备开展获得原先并不掌握的信息的研究活动，所以利益集团明显成为政策制定者的信息源根据综述性研究调查，利益集团为立法者提供包括政策偏好效应、政策如何影响立法者所在选区的技术信息以及有关立法者最好如何投票的信息等各种不同的知识。
Translation: Accounts such as those by Birnbaum and Murray (1987), Smith (1988), and Birnbaum (1992) depict a vivid picture of special interest agents being involved in nearly every stage of the legislative process through news reports on lobbying activities. The specific activities of lobbyists include meeting with policy sympathizers, helping to devise legislative strategies, assisting legislators in drafting bills, visiting undecided legislators to secure their support, and undermining legislative deals among lawmakers, among others. Why is the power of lobbyists so pervasive in Washington or state capitals? Research based on news reporting and confirmatory interview surveys indicates that lobbyists possess a clear informational advantage. Since legislators must deal with a large number of complex and highly technical issues, it is unrealistic to expect them to acquire all relevant knowledge using only their own resources and expertise. Interest groups, by virtue of their daily involvement in policy decisions, are already familiar with many technical details and are prepared to conduct research to obtain information they do not already possess. Thus, interest groups clearly become an important source of information for policymakers. According to comprehensive survey research, interest groups provide legislators with various types of knowledge, including information on policy preference effects, technical details on how policies will affect the legislators’ constituencies, and advice on how legislators should best vote.

Query_Text_cn: 我们通过华盛顿游说组织的规模数据获得对游说活动规模的感性认识。得益于《1995年游说活动许可法》，我们可以获得近年来游说活动的数据。根据《游说活动许可法》的要求，游说企业必须每半年公帝其估计超过20000美元的游说活动的收人。同样地，雇用游说者的组织必须每两年公布超过10000美元的游说关联费用.游说者的法律定义是至少将自己20%的时间用于对特定客户的游说活动，游说者可以是与几个立法机构的职员、国会的议员或高层次的行政管理人员签订合约的人员，也可以是服务期为S个月、支付5000美元以上的游说服务报酬的机构人员.所有游说者都必须在政府注册登记.6个月内的游说费用支出超过20000美元的企业必须雇用内部游说人员。
Translation: We gain an intuitive understanding of the scale of lobbying activities through data on the size of lobbying organizations in Washington. Thanks to the Lobbying Disclosure Act of 1995, we are able to access data on lobbying activities in recent years. According to the requirements of the Lobbying Disclosure Act, lobbying firms must publicly disclose their lobbying income if it exceeds $20,000 within a six-month period. Similarly, organizations that hire lobbyists must disclose their lobbying-related expenses if they exceed $10,000 every two years. The legal definition of a lobbyist is someone who spends at least 20% of their time lobbying on behalf of a specific client. Lobbyists can be individuals contracted with staff from several legislative bodies, members of Congress, or senior executive officials, as well as institutional personnel who provide lobbying services for more than three months and receive over $5,000 in compensation. All lobbyists must be registered with the government. Firms that spend more than $20,000 on lobbying expenses within six months are required to employ in-house lobbyists.

Query_Text_cn: 政治反应中心（1999)汇集了1997年至1999年上半年的游说者及游说机构报告的各种文件数据，并在影响力公司（Influence，Inc.)公布统计汇总结果我们发现，截至1999年7月15日，注册登记的游说者总数为20512人，比1997年9月30日登记在册的14964名游说者增加37%，依法登记注册的游说人员在1998年的联邦游说费用为U.2亿美元，比1997年的12.6亿美元相应增加13%。游说费用涉及各种不同的团体，处于首位的金融、保险与不动产行业的游说费用为2.08亿美元，其次分别是通信和电力行业（1.S6亿美元）、其他商务分类（1-72亿美元）、包括卫生专业人员的卫生行业（1.65亿美元）、能源与自然资源部门C1.44亿美元），以及农业行业19亿美元根据文化问题或其他非经济问题的不同观点形成的单一问题和意识琨态的组织在1998年的联邦游说费用支出为7600万美元，工会组织的游说费用支出为2400万美元。游说支出总费用超过联邦政府的相应竞选运动补助总额，这就使得游说与追随流行商品一样昂贵。
Translation: The Center for Responsive Politics (1999) compiled various data from reports submitted by lobbyists and lobbying organizations from 1997 to the first half of 1999. According to the statistical summary released by Influence, Inc., as of July 15, 1999, the total number of registered lobbyists was 20,512, representing a 37% increase from the 14,964 lobbyists registered as of September 30, 1997. In 1998, the federally registered lobbying expenditures amounted to $1.42 billion, a 13% increase compared to $1.26 billion in 1997. Lobbying expenditures involved a wide range of groups, with the financial, insurance, and real estate industries ranking first at $208 million, followed by the communications and electric power industries ($156 million), other business categories ($172 million), the health sector including health professionals ($165 million), the energy and natural resources sector ($144 million), and the agricultural sector ($90 million). Organizations formed around single issues and ideologies based on cultural or other non-economic perspectives spent $76 million on federal lobbying in 1998, while labor unions spent $24 million. The total lobbying expenditures exceeded the corresponding amount of federal government campaign subsidies, making lobbying as expensive as following popular consumer trends.

Query_Text_cn: 利益集团除为立法者提供信息和劝说立法者外，许多特殊利益集团试图教育一般公众.根据施洛茨曼和蒂尔尼（SchlozmanandTierney,1986)对代理机构的调结果，86%的代理机枸为大众媒体提供信息，44%的代理机构尝试公开候选者的参选经历，31K的代理机构通过媒体广告宣传政策主张，22%的代理机构认可自身偏好的候选者尽管安娜博格公共政策中心(AnnenbergPublicPolicyCenter)尝试跟踪调查利益集团从1994年以来的广告，但还是难以判断利益集团活动的规模。安娜博格公共政策中心调在1997?1998年度选举期间广播媒体播出的公众关心的广告以及77个组织投播的423个不同广告，估计相应的广告费用在2.75亿美元至3.4亿美元之间。
Translation: In addition to providing information to legislators and lobbying them, many special interest groups also attempt to educate the general public. According to a survey of advocacy organizations conducted by Schlozman and Tierney (1986), 86% of advocacy organizations provide information to mass media, 44% attempt to publicize candidates' campaign experiences, 31% promote policy positions through media advertising, and 22% endorse candidates who share their preferences. Although the Annenberg Public Policy Center has attempted to track interest group advertising since 1994, it remains difficult to determine the scale of interest group activities. During the 1997–1998 election cycle, the Annenberg Public Policy Center tracked public interest ads broadcast by the media and identified 423 different ads placed by 77 organizations, estimating the associated advertising costs to be between $275 million and $340 million.

Query_Text_cn: 利益集团展开各种不同活动的原因基本上与游说活动的原因相同。典型的投票者甚至是立法者缺乏评价不同政策提议所必需的经验和技术信息进一步地，个人几乎没有动机去承担研究相关政策问题细节的成本。根据投票者从媒体、直接的邮件宣传物品或其他免费信息渠道获得信息的程度可以看出，投票者渴望获取信息.对于特殊利益集团而言f他们通过教育公众可以尽量形成同情自身政策主张的公众观点，特殊利益集团乐意成为公众的教育者。
Translation: The reasons why interest groups engage in various activities are essentially the same as those for lobbying. Typical voters, and even legislators, lack the expertise and technical information necessary to evaluate different policy proposals. Furthermore, individuals have little incentive to bear the costs of researching the details of relevant policy issues. The extent to which voters obtain information from the media, direct mailings, or other free information channels demonstrates their desire for information. For special interest groups, educating the public is a way to shape public opinion sympathetic to their policy positions, and they are therefore willing to act as educators to the public.

Query_Text_cn: 利益集团的领导者也投入资源教育自己集团的成员。根据施洛茨曼和蒂尔尼（SchlozmanandTierney，186)的访问调查，72%的组织认为自己花费了大量时间和资源来教育自己集团的成员，其他20%的组织认为自己也花费了一定的时间和资源来教育自己集团的成员。利益集团的领导者同其普通成员进行内部交流的作用在于，改变普通成员对即将举行的国会议题的认识，并且为普通成员提供立法机构考虑的各种政策给予自己影响程度的信息。利益集团成员之间的一般交流方法是通过组织机构的杂志或时事通讯的常规媒体.但也采用直接邮送宣传品和针对性广告的方法。
Translation: Leaders of interest groups also invest resources in educating their own members. According to a survey conducted by Schlozman and Tierney (186), 72% of organizations believe they spend a significant amount of time and resources on educating their members, while another 20% believe they also devote a certain amount of time and resources to this purpose. The internal communication between interest group leaders and their rank-and-file members serves to change members’ perceptions of upcoming congressional issues and to provide information on the extent of their influence over various policies under consideration by the legislature. The most common method of communication among interest group members is through regular media such as organizational magazines or newsletters, but direct mailings of promotional materials and targeted advertising are also used.

Query_Text_cn: 特殊利益集团不常采用示威抗议活动的方式。1999年11月，世界贸易组织部长级会议期间发生的500多个非政府组织参加的抗议活动就是利益集团采用抗议活动形式的事例。利益集团的抗议活动还可以理解成利益集团尝拭教育政策制定者、利益集团成员和一般公众的其他方法手段。围绕抗议活动的媒体报道以及经常伴随利益集团的辩论会都提供了直接信息。然而，当利益集团的参与者感觉到对政策议题信息的厌恶和不舒适时，间接途径可能传递了更多的信息.根据施洛茨曼和蒂尔尼（StrhkmnanandTierney，1986)的访问调查可知，20%的组织参加一定形式的示威抗议活动，贝里（Berry，I977)以及诺尼思和弗里曼（NtownesandFreeman,I"8)的研究得出，23%和21%的组织参加示威抗议活动。
Translation: Special interest groups do not often adopt demonstrations and protest activities as their main approach. However, the protest involving more than 500 non-governmental organizations during the WTO Ministerial Conference in November 1999 is an example of interest groups using such forms of action. The protest activities of interest groups can also be understood as another method by which these groups attempt to educate policymakers, their own members, and the general public. Media coverage surrounding protests, as well as debates often accompanied by interest groups, provide direct information. However, when participants in interest groups feel aversion or discomfort toward information on policy issues, indirect channels may actually convey more information. According to a survey by Schlozman and Tierney (1986), 20% of organizations participate in some form of demonstration or protest activity. Studies by Berry (1977) and Nownes and Freeman (1998) found that 23% and 21% of organizations, respectively, participate in protest activities.

Query_Text_cn: 上述利益集团的所有活动都只涉及信息的各种不同传递方法.另一种与利益集团接触信息无关的方法是利益集团为候选者和政党提供资源。根据施洛茨曼和蒂尔尼（SchlozmanandTiemeyf1986)的访问调查可知，58%的组织提供竞选活动的资金赞助，还有24%的组织提供竞选活动的人力或人事的帮助。当然，近年显然更广泛地议论了竞选活动的资助。几乎每天都有媒体报道金钱利益在选举过程中所起的作用。
Translation: All the activities of the aforementioned interest groups only involve various methods of information transmission. Another way interest groups interact, unrelated to information, is by providing resources to candidates and political parties. According to a survey conducted by Schlozman and Tierney (1986), 58% of organizations offer financial sponsorship for campaign activities, while 24% provide manpower or personnel assistance. Of course, in recent years, campaign financing has been discussed much more extensively. Almost every day, the media reports on the role of monetary interests in the electoral process.

Query_Text_cn: 特姝利益集团提供的竞选活动捐款已经得到联邦法律的认可。国会在1907年宣布公司和贸易协会向联邦候选人直接捐款为非法行为，1943年禁止直接捐款的范围扩大到工会组织，20世纪70年代初期，许多工会组织和其他组织找到避开法律限制的方法。他们建立了政治行动委员会，而政治行动委员会是代表利益集筹集个人自愿捐款，并且将筹集得到的捐款转送给候选者和政党的独立组织。U974年联邦选举竞选法》从法律上认可政治行动委员会的实践活动，导致政治行动委员会的数量增加和激发政治行动委员会的活动。公司的政治行动委员会的数量从1974年的89个增加到1988年的1816个，而1999年底的政治行动委员会数量下降至1548个。1977年以前并不存在的“无关联”（nonconnected)政治行动委员会的数量在1988年是1115个，而1999年底降到972个。工会组织的政治行动委员会的数量从1974年的210个稳步增加到1984年高峰期的394个，至1999年变成31S个。《联邦选举竞选法》也限制政治行动委员会的捐款数量（至少拥有50个捐赠人和至少向5个候选人提供捐款的政治行动委员会在每年选举中向候选人最多捐款5000美元，并且每年向全国性政党最多捐款b000美元），政治行动委员会的总捐款呈现飞跃式增长。
Translation: Campaign contributions provided by special interest groups have been recognized by federal law. In 1907, Congress declared it illegal for corporations and trade associations to make direct contributions to federal candidates, and in 1943, the ban on direct contributions was extended to labor unions. In the early 1970s, many labor unions and other organizations found ways to circumvent these legal restrictions. They established political action committees (PACs), which are independent organizations that collect voluntary individual contributions on behalf of interest groups and then transfer the funds raised to candidates and political parties. The Federal Election Campaign Act of 1974 legally recognized the activities of PACs, leading to an increase in their number and stimulating their activities. The number of corporate PACs rose from 89 in 1974 to 1,816 in 1988, but by the end of 1999, the number had declined to 1,548. The number of "nonconnected" PACs, which did not exist before 1977, reached 1,115 in 1988 and dropped to 972 by the end of 1999. The number of labor union PACs steadily increased from 210 in 1974 to a peak of 394 in 1984, and then declined to 315 by 1999. The Federal Election Campaign Act also limits the amount PACs can contribute (a PAC with at least 50 donors and contributions to at least five candidates may contribute up to $5,000 per candidate per election and up to $5,000 per year to a national party), but the total contributions from PACs have shown a dramatic increase.

Query_Text_cn: 在1973-1974年间，政治行动委员会向国会议员候选人提供的捐款总量为1240万美元s在1978-1979年间，相应的捐款总量将近增加了2倍，达到3410万美元在1983?1984年间，国会候选人获得的捐款又增加了2倍，达到了1.053亿美元，随后不断增松，1987?198S年间的总捐款为1.511亿美元，1991?1992年间的总捐款为1.794亿美元，而1997?1998年间选举的总捐款达到2.0S6亿美元在1997?1998年间的捐款中，公司的政治行动委员会捐款7800万美元，工会组织的政治行动委员会捐款4500万美元，而“无关联”政治行动委员会的捐款为2S00万美元。政治行动委员会的捐款压倒性地资助现任国会议员（1997-1998年间为现任国会议院提供的捐款占总捐款的而政治行动委员会的捐款占1997-1998年间国会候选人获得总资助的30%。
Translation: Between 1973 and 1974, the total amount of donations provided by political action committees (PACs) to congressional candidates was $12.4 million. During 1978-1979, the corresponding total nearly doubled, reaching $34.1 million. In 1983-1984, donations to congressional candidates doubled again, reaching $105.3 million, and continued to increase thereafter. The total donations for 1987-1988 were $151.1 million, $179.4 million for 1991-1992, and reached $205.6 million during the 1997-1998 elections. Of the donations in 1997-1998, corporate PACs contributed $78 million, labor union PACs contributed $45 million, and "nonconnected" PACs contributed $25 million. PAC donations overwhelmingly supported incumbent members of Congress (in 1997-1998, the donations to incumbents accounted for the majority of total donations), and PAC donations made up 30% of the total funding received by congressional candidates during the 1997-1998 period.

Query_Text_cn: 从20世纪80年代初期开始，特殊利益集团又寻找到避开向联邦候选人和全国性政党提供捐款的法律条款限制的新方法。法律限制条款的空隙在于联邦法律与各州法律之间的差异。多数州并不禁止公司和工会组织向政党捐款，也不限制政治行动委员会的捐款数量;部分州的捐款限制条款比联邦法律规定得宽松。根据1978年联邦选举委员会咨询顾问的意见和1978年以来选举案件的法律判决意见，《联邦选举竞选法》的解释变为，只要不是(明显地)直接有利于单个联邦选举的候选人，允许全国性政党在各州筹集捐款，但要受到各州对分担政党行政费用、投票者和参加者的活动费用、选举广告费用以及其他费用的约束s规则解释的变更孕育了所谓“纸币”金融，全国性政党可以无限制地筹集特殊利益集团的捐款，并将获得的捐款再分配给可能需要更多选举费用的各州的政党组织.各州的政党组织根据最有利于政党的国会选举与总统选举C例如，刊登宣传政党的政策主张的广告)和联邦法律约束人均捐款费用的方式来使用得到的捐款。
Translation: Since the early 1980s, special interest groups have found new ways to circumvent legal restrictions on donations to federal candidates and national political parties. The loophole in the legal restrictions lies in the differences between federal and state laws. Most states do not prohibit corporations and labor unions from donating to political parties, nor do they limit the amount that political action committees can contribute; some states have looser donation limits than those set by federal law. According to advisory opinions of the Federal Election Commission in 1978 and legal rulings in election cases since 1978, the interpretation of the Federal Election Campaign Act changed: as long as the donations are not (explicitly) directly benefiting an individual federal candidate, national political parties are allowed to raise funds in the states, but are subject to state regulations regarding the sharing of party administrative expenses, costs of voter and participant activities, election advertising expenses, and other expenditures. This change in rule interpretation gave rise to the so-called “soft money” financing, allowing national political parties to raise unlimited donations from special interest groups and redistribute the funds to state party organizations that may need more election funding. State party organizations then use the donations in ways most advantageous to the party’s congressional and presidential elections (for example, running advertisements promoting the party’s policy positions), while adhering to federal legal constraints on per capita donation expenditures.

Query_Text_cn: 从1991年开始，联邦选举委员会才要求公布纸币捐款的情况，而且只公布对全国性政党的捐款。根据科拉多等（Conradoet吐，1即7)的第173页，共和党与民主党在1979?1980年度与1983?1984年度选举中，纸币捐款总量分别为1910万美元和216C万美元。从20世纪80年代中期开始，纸币捐款的数量直线增加，根据两个政党的全闰委员会提供的数字，1993?1994年的纸币捐款数量为107万美元，而1995?1996年与1997-1998年的纸捐款数量分别达到2612万美元和2244万美元。截至2000年6月，全国性政党已经为2000年度的选举筹集到2560万美元的资金。1999年度的统计数字显示，商业团体与公司是提供了总额8070万美元的纸币捐款的最大捐款者。1999年，全国性政党从工会组织获得690万美元的纸币捐款，而从意识形态团体和其他组织(多数为类似“全国枪支协会”这样的单一政策议题的团体)获得160万美元的捐款。
Translation: It was only starting in 1991 that the Federal Election Commission required the disclosure of soft money donations, and even then, only donations to national political parties were made public. According to page 173 of Conrado et al. (1997), the total amount of soft money donations to the Republican and Democratic parties during the 1979–1980 and 1983–1984 election cycles was $19.1 million and $21.6 million, respectively. Beginning in the mid-1980s, the amount of soft money donations increased sharply. According to figures provided by the national committees of the two parties, soft money donations in 1993–1994 totaled $10.7 million, while in 1995–1996 and 1997–1998, the amounts reached $261.2 million and $224.4 million, respectively. As of June 2000, national political parties had already raised $256 million for the 2000 election cycle. Statistics from 1999 show that business groups and corporations were the largest donors of soft money, contributing a total of $80.7 million. In 1999, national political parties received $6.9 million in soft money donations from labor unions, and $1.6 million from ideological groups and other organizations (most of which were single-issue groups such as the National Rifle Association).

Query_Text_cn: 特殊利益集团利用得到的硬通货和纸币捐款来购买什么呢？社会科学家们与政策团体一直在争论这个问题，但还没有形成共识部分学者认为，捐款购买的是游说者与立法者接触，并说明自己政策主张的准人机会。多数游说者坚持认为捐款的目的就是获取准入机会，一些前任国会议员也赞成对准人机会的解释。例如，纽约的前任国会议员托马斯?唐ja(ThoinaSDowney)就主张：“金钱并不能购买职位，但金钱确实能帮你购买准人机会，使你可以制定法律。”[参见施拉姆（Schram，1995,第63页）上前任参议院多数党领袖乔治?米切尔（GerogeMitchdl)也认为：“我认为金钱帮助游说者获得陈述自己观点的机会，而这种机会在其他场合是没有的。”[参见施拉姆(Schram，1995,第61页）]。
Translation: What do special interest groups use the hard currency and cash donations they receive to buy? Social scientists and policy groups have long debated this question, but no consensus has been reached. Some scholars believe that donations are used to purchase access—the opportunity for lobbyists to meet with legislators and present their policy positions. Most lobbyists insist that the purpose of donations is precisely to gain such access, and some former members of Congress also support this explanation. For example, former New York Congressman Thomas Downey argued, “Money can’t buy you a vote, but it can buy you access, which allows you to help make the law.” [See Schram, 1995, p. 63.] Former Senate Majority Leader George Mitchell also stated, “I believe that money helps lobbyists get the opportunity to present their views—an opportunity that is not available in other circumstances.” [See Schram, 1995, p. 61.]

Query_Text_cn: 若需 “购买” 与立法者接触的机会，原因可能在于立法者将自身时间视为稀缺资源。正如唐尼议员所言：“要见到国会议员并不容易。这并非因为他们刻意回避，而是因为他们实在繁忙 —— 既要处理国会委员会的工作，又要在选区与国会之间往返奔波，还要维持办公室约见安排并与选区选民会面。”[参见施拉姆（Schram，1995，第 63 页）]。在这种情况下，立法者安排日程时，至少会在一定程度上参考竞选捐款情况。
Translation: If one needs to "purchase" opportunities to interact with legislators, it may be because legislators regard their own time as a scarce resource. As Congressman Downey noted, "It is not easy to meet with a Member of Congress. This is not because they deliberately avoid people, but because they are extremely busy—handling committee work, shuttling between their district and Congress, maintaining office appointments, and meeting with constituents." [See Schram, 1995, p. 63.] Under such circumstances, legislators, when scheduling their time, will at least to some extent take campaign contributions into consideration.

Query_Text_cn: 国会议员时间稀缺性的主张存在逻辑困难t如果特殊利益集团愿意支付准人费用，就会知道自己有机会与立法者交流自身的政策主张。这意味着利益集团希望拥有或获得劝说立法者支持利益集团政策主张的信息。如果利益集团具有对政策制定者有价值的信息，政策制定者就应该同意访问最有可能提供有用信息的利益集团。只有当金钱向立法者传递利益集团需要提供有价值信息的信号或立法者不考虑自己的时间价格而只注重竞选费用支出的潜在资金来源时，金钱才在约会时间安排的问题上起作用。
Translation: The argument regarding the scarcity of legislators' time faces logical difficulties. If special interest groups are willing to pay access fees, it indicates that they believe they have an opportunity to communicate their policy positions to lawmakers. This implies that interest groups either possess or seek to acquire information that could persuade legislators to support their policy proposals. If interest groups hold information valuable to policymakers, policymakers should agree to meet with those groups most likely to provide useful information.
